title: Senior Full-Stack AI Engineer
description:
Senior Full-Stack AI Engineer


Location: Brazil (Remote)



About Sphise Technologies


Sphise Technologies is a global outsourcing and talent solutions company, partnering with high-growth businesses to build strong, high-impact teams across finance, technology, and operations.

Our trusted high-growth technology partner is building a production AI platform that transforms disconnected data into measurable business growth. With customers already onboarding and the platform live in production, they are hiring a Senior Full-Stack AI Engineer to scale their next-generation AI systems.



Position Overview:


We are seeking a Senior Full-Stack AI Engineer to own the intersection of agentic AI and modern web development . You will build the intelligent backend powering a multi-agent system and the interactive frontend delivering real-time AI experiences . This role requires strong architectural judgment — the platform runs on Vercel , and decisions around caching, bandwidth, cost efficiency, and production reliability are critical.

If you are excited about building AI agents that work in production , designing streaming chat experiences , and solving complex orchestration challenges , this is the opportunity for you.



What You'll Do:


  • Design and optimize production prompts for LLMs and build multi-agent workflows with smart routing, specialization, and human-in-the-loop approval gates
  • Build stateful agent workflows with planning, execution, and observation loops — making sure agents reliably follow structured steps even when users go off-script
  • Create streaming chat UIs with real-time rendering, tool call visualization, and interactive artifacts
  • Connect agents to analytical databases for live data retrieval, SQL generation, and knowledge base access through RAG pipelines
  • Own performance across the full stack — caching strategies, bandwidth optimization, and keeping Vercel costs under control
  • Implement LLMOps practices including prompt versioning, observability, and cost tracking.



What You Bring


  • 3–5+ years of progressive experience in full-stack development.
  • Strong TypeScript skills across frontend, backend, and agent logic
  • Production experience with React or Next.js (App Router, Server Components, API routes)
  • Hands-on work with LLM agent frameworks — LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen, or custom agent loops
  • Production prompt engineering: system prompts, chain-of-thought reasoning, tool-calling patterns
  • Direct experience with LLM APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic, or open-source models)
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience



Nice to Have

  • Experience with Vercel AI SDK (useChat, streamText, streaming patterns)
  • Familiarity with durable workflow engines like Trigger.dev or Temporal
  • Experience with RAG pipelines, vector databases, or knowledge retrieval systems
  • Background in performance optimization for Vercel-hosted applications
  • Experience at an early-stage startup or building a product from 0 to 1.



Benefits:

  • Competitive salary to recognise and reward your achievements.
  • Flexible work environment.
  • Opportunities for professional and personal growth.

title: AWS DevOps Engineer
description:
About You

You are a hands-on DevOps or Infrastructure Engineer who enjoys taking ownership of Infrastructure as Code and building reliable, cloud-native environments on AWS. You are comfortable working with Terraform, provisioning container-based infrastructure, and ensuring platform stability through proper monitoring and observability.


You bring a proactive mindset, enjoy questioning technical decisions, and collaborate closely with distributed teams to continuously improve infrastructure reliability, security, and scalability.


  • This position is offered under a contractor model for an initial period of 6 months , with the possibility of extension.


You Bring to Applaudo the Following Competencies:

  • 5+ years of professional experience in DevOps or Infrastructure Engineering roles.
  • Strong hands-on experience with Terraform and Terraform Cloud , including writing modules and managing provisioning workflows.
  • Proven experience provisioning and managing AWS infrastructure , primarily ECS and related container services.
  • Deep understanding of Docker and container-based architectures.
  • Experience implementing monitoring and observability using CloudWatch and Datadog.
  • Familiarity with compliance practices and security-driven infrastructure changes.
  • Strong English communication skills to collaborate with distributed teams and US-based stakeholders.
  • Proactive and curious mindset, comfortable reviewing and questioning technical decisions and architectures.
  • Exposure to AI-assisted development tools such as GitHub Copilot (nice to have).


You Will Be Accountable for the Following Responsibilities:

  • Write and maintain Terraform code and modules to provision and manage AWS infrastructure using Terraform Cloud.
  • Review Terraform pull requests and provide feedback to ensure code quality and best practices.
  • Provision AWS services and work on proofs of concept (PoCs) to validate infrastructure solutions.
  • Apply infrastructure and configuration changes driven by Security and Compliance requirements.
  • Review and challenge architecture and implementation approaches to drive continuous improvement.
  • Participate in team ceremonies, including daily standups and technical discussions.
  • Collaborate closely with other engineers to ensure infrastructure reliability, scalability, and maintainability.


Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience with Terraform and Terraform Cloud.
  • Strong experience with AWS infrastructure (ECS and container services).
  • Experience with Docker, CloudWatch, and Datadog.
  • Conversational English (B2+).


Additional Information

About Us


At Applaudo , we partner with ambitious companies to transform through technology with an AI-native mindset at the core of how we think, build, and deliver. We combine strategic clarity, world-class execution, and modern engineering practices to help clients accelerate measurable business outcomes and stay competitive.


We are building a high-performance culture grounded in five values: Empowering Excellence, Collaborative Teamwork, Unsolicited Respect, Consistent Transparency, and Efficient Communication. These define how we work, how we make decisions, and how we hold ourselves accountable.


Applaudo is a place for people who want to grow fast, take ownership, and work alongside strong teams. Joining us means being part of an organization that is evolving intentionally, investing in modern ways of working, and embracing AI as a lever for productivity, innovation, and impact.

Descrição da Vaga:

“Estamos buscando um Engenheiro Sênior de Automação de Mainframe experiente para liderar a migração e otimização de soluções de automação em mainframe. Esta função tem como foco a transição do CA OPS/MVS para o IBM Tivoli Systems Automation for z/OS e do CA Automation Point para o IBM Systems Automation for Integrated Operations Management (SAIOM) .

O candidato ideal terá um papel crítico para garantir a eficiência operacional, a disponibilidade dos sistemas e processos de automação contínuos em um ambiente z/OS complexo.

Você irá colaborar de perto com a equipe de Automação para implementar soluções de automação baseadas em políticas, reduzir a sobrecarga administrativa e aumentar a capacidade de resposta dos sistemas. Esta posição não impacta o desenvolvimento de aplicações, mas influencia significativamente as estratégias e operações de automação.”


Principais Responsabilidades:

  • Documentar processos, configurações e etapas de migração, garantindo comunicação clara com as partes interessadas.
  • Identificar e resolver problemas relacionados à automação em ambientes de produção.


Quais são as habilidades obrigatórias e níveis de proficiência exigidos para esta posição?

  • Experiência em Operações de Mainframe: Mínimo de 5+ anos em ambiente de operações de mainframe, em funções operacionais, de serviços, consultoria ou suporte.
  • IBM Tivoli Systems Automation for z/OS: Conhecimento avançado e experiência prática.
  • CA OPS/MVS: Avançado.
  • TSO e ISPF: Proficiência no uso dessas ferramentas para gerenciamento de sistemas.
  • JCL: Fortes habilidades em Job Control Language.
  • Programação REXX: Capacidade de escrever e manter scripts REXX.
  • System Automation Policy Database (PDB): Conhecimento prático obrigatório.
  • Experiência em Migração: Histórico comprovado em projetos de migração de automação em z/OS.
  • NetView for z/OS: Experiência na implementação e utilização deste produto.
  • Scripting REXX: Avançado.


Quais são as habilidades opcionais e níveis de proficiência desejáveis para esta posição?

  • Conhecimento de outros softwares IBM Z, incluindo operação, configuração e automação de sistemas.
  • Familiaridade com processos de inicialização e desligamento do sistema z/OS.
  • Experiência com SMP/E para instalação e manutenção de software.
  • Entendimento de produtos de automação concorrentes no ecossistema de mainframe.
  • Especialização em configurações de sistemas totalmente automatizados em IBM Z.

title: Tech Lead Salesforce Developer
description:
Tech Lead Salesforce Developer


Important Information

Location: Brazil

Job Mode: Full-time

Work Mode: Work from home

Job Summary


We are seeking an experienced Senior Salesforce Developer with Data Cloud experience to support a strategic initiative focused on reducing customer churn by integrating and enriching customer data across multiple platforms. This role will work closely with the Salesforce Architect, data engineering teams, and cross-functional partners to ingest, unify, and expose data within Salesforce CRM and Salesforce Data 360 (Data Cloud).

Responsibilities and Duties


  • Lead end-to-end ingestion and mapping of customer data from Salesforce CRM, Siebel, Azure/Microsoft Fabric, Oracle, and churn model outputs into Salesforce Data 360;
  • Design, build, and maintain identity and account unification rules to produce accurate customer matching and golden records;
  • Create scalable, repeatable pipelines for ingestion, transformation, mapping, and controlled promotion across environments (including Data 360 data kits);
  • Enrich Salesforce CRM records with Data 360 attributes and analytics/model insights (e.g., churn) using related lists, dynamic related lists, and custom UI components;
  • Support CRM data strategy during the Siebel-to-Salesforce migration, prioritizing Salesforce CRM as the system of engagement as adoption increases;
  • Develop and support APIs and integration services for secure internal consumption of Data 360 and CRM data; partner with architecture/engineering on integration patterns and implement ETL when native connectors don’t meet requirements;
  • Monitor and optimize Data 360 credit consumption to balance cost, performance, and SLAs;
  • Enable business teams to use enriched customer data for segmentation, activation, and analytics use cases;
  • Document processes, standards, and runbooks; contribute to shared enablement resources to drive adoption and operational continuity.

Essential Skills


  • Experience with Salesforce development;
  • Strong proficiency in: Apex, SOQL/SOSL, Lightning Web Components (LWC), Salesforce core data model, Salesforce APIs (REST/SOAP/Bulk), and integration design patterns;
  • Hands-on experience with Data ingestion and harmonization, Identity resolution and unification rules, Data kits and environment promotion, Large-scale data processing;
  • Experience connecting Salesforce Data Cloud/Data 360 to external systems (Azure/Microsoft Fabric, Oracle, Siebel, or similar), including when to use native connectors vs. custom integrations;
  • Experience with ETL processes and/or tools (e.g., Informatica, MuleSoft, Talend, Databricks);
  • Experience working in Agile/Scrum teams;
  • Strong technical communication skills, able to translate complex concepts for architects, engineers, business users, and leadership.

Highly Desirable Skills


  • Experience with Salesforce Marketing Cloud, especially data activation and segmentation;
  • Experience with Siebel CRM integration and/or data migration;
  • Knowledge of telecom customer data, churn analytics, or Customer 360 implementations;
  • Familiarity with Azure data engineering and Microsoft Fabric connector limitations;
  • Understanding of scalable deployment pipelines and DevOps tooling (Git, CI/CD).

About Encora


Encora is the preferred digital engineering and modernization partner of some of the world’s leading enterprises and digital native companies. With over 9,000 experts in 47+ offices and innovation labs worldwide, Encora’s technology practices include Product Engineering & Development, Cloud Services, Quality Engineering, DevSecOps, Data & Analytics, Digital Experience, Cybersecurity, and AI & LLM Engineering.

title: Pessoa Especialista de Dados e DevOps
description:
Sobre a vaga:

A Dimensa está no topo do jogo quando o assunto é tecnologia e infraestrutura para operações financeiras, crédito e risco, e seguros. Nossos sistemas são super escaláveis e adaptáveis, perfeitos para negócios de todos os tamanhos. Nossa equipe de experts vive e respira o setor financeiro, atualizando nossas soluções constantemente para tornar suas operações mais digitais, melhorar a performance, inovar no atendimento aos clientes e garantir que todas as exigências regulatórias sejam 100% cumpridas.


Todas as nossas oportunidades são inclusivas e abertas para pessoas com deficiência.


O DESAFIO:

  • Projetar, implementar e gerenciar pipelines de CI/CD para entrega contínua de aplicações com qualidade e segurança.
  • Automatizar o provisionamento e configuração de ambientes utilizando Infraestrutura como Código (IaC).
  • Trabalhar em conjunto com desenvolvedores, SREs e engenheiros de plataforma para garantir confiabilidade e eficiência no ciclo de vida das aplicações.
  • Integrar validações de segurança e qualidade (DevSecOps) nos pipelines de entrega.
  • Apoiar times de desenvolvimento na adoção de práticas de GitOps, automação de deploys e rollback seguro.
  • Implementar e gerenciar soluções de observabilidade, garantindo que logs, métricas e alertas estejam integrados ao fluxo de entrega.
  • Automatizar operações relacionadas a bancos de dados, como migrations, versionamento e sincronização entre ambientes.
  • Atuar em conjunto com o time de DBA para garantir que as mudanças em dados sejam seguras, rastreáveis e padronizadas.
  • Colaborar na evolução das plataformas de containers (ex: Kubernetes, OpenShift), otimizando deploys e escalabilidade.
  • Promover cultura DevOps entre os times, disseminando boas práticas de colaboração e automação.


O QUE VOCÊ PRECISA:

  • Pipelines de CI/CD: GitLab CI/CD, Jenkins, ArgoCD, Tekton, ou equivalentes.
  • Infraestrutura como Código: Terraform, CloudFormation, Pulumi.
  • Contêineres e Orquestração: Docker, Kubernetes (EKS, GKE, AKS).
  • Monitoramento e Observabilidade: Prometheus, Grafana, ELK/EFK, Datadog.
  • Versionamento e Gestão de Código: Git, GitOps.
  • Automação de Banco de Dados: ferramentas como Liquibase, Flyway, Alembic.
  • Cloud Pública: AWS, Azure ou GCP.
  • Linguagens de automação: Python, Bash, Go (desejável).
  • Segurança em pipelines: integração de SAST, DAST, IaC scanning.

️ Vale Refeição/Vale Alimentação (flexível)

Assistência Médica

title: Planejador Financeiro/ Planejador Patrimonial (Pessoa Física)
description:

Essa vaga é direcionada a assessores que tenham uma carteira ativa de clientes ou tenham uma rede de relacionamentos alta renda que possibilitem a construção de uma. 

Se essa oportunidade se alinha ao seu perfil e ao que você busca, inscreva-se! 


Veja mais detalhes sobre o Grupo Capita e a vaga, que terá início em 13/10/25:

Assessorias, bancos e corretoras costumam bater metas nos clientes, enquanto deveriam bater as metas dos clientes.


Na contra-mão desse modelo, repleto de conflito de interesse, nasce o Grupo Capital, uma organização formada por pessoas que colocam seus clientes verdadeiramente em primeiro lugar.


Além de acesso às melhores soluções do mercado e um método exclusivo, validado por mais de 4 mil clientes, somos associados à Planejar, instituição responsável pelo CFP® no Brasil. 


Com o propósito de conquistar além, somos profissionais comprometidos em fazer a diferença, impulsionando o sucesso e prosperidade de cada indivíduo com quem interagimos.


Seu desenvolvimento junto ao Grupo Capita l:


A evolução da sua carreira é prioridade! Por isso você terá acesso à ferramentas, especialistas certificados, mentores e um programa estruturado de partnership, para que você possa se tornar sócio do Grupo Capital.


Durante o seu onboarding você aprenderá tudo o que precisa sobre a metodologia exclusiva de planejamento financeiro e patrimonial e as habilidades técnicas e comportamentais, sempre envolvendo estudos de caso reais e prática.


Por fim, pedir e dar feedbacks comportamentais, técnicos ou sobre processos, está no nosso dia a dia. Acreditamos que feedbacks de qualidade são a chave para o verdadeiro desenvolvimento.

  • Realizar as vendas consultivas necessárias para que os clientes alcancem seus objetivos;
  • Aconselhar de forma adequada os recursos financeiros dos clientes. 


Pré-requisitos:


  • Colocar o cliente em primeiro lugar sempre;

  • Interesse em receber e dar feedback;
  • Comunicação clara, escuta ativa, carisma e simpatia;

Diferencial:

  • Oportunidade de desenvolver novos projetos/ produtos junto ao Grupo Capital;

Modo de contratação:

title: Lead Engineer (JAVA)
description:
We Are Sportingtech :


Sportingtech is a multi-award-winning provider of turnkey betting and gaming solutions designed for regulated and emerging markets around the world. With offices in Malta, Bulgaria, London, Brazil and Portugal, our iGaming platform offers everything covering sportsbook and casino via a modular system and intuitive back office for a fully omni-channel solution. Our unparalleled ability to cater for local-market customisation and operator preferences provides players with an optimal betting experience, resulting in proven growth for our rapidly expanding customer base.



Where you Fit In:


As a JAVA Lead Engineer , you are a senior, hands-on engineer responsible for designing and delivering high-quality Java-based solutions in a transactional, distributed environment. You shape and execute technical direction in close collaboration with Architecture and Principal Engineers, ensuring the team’s implementation aligns with agreed standards, target architecture, and operational constraints.


The impact you will have:


Hands-on engineering & delivery (primary)

  • Design, implement, and maintain backend services and APIs primarily in Java (and relevant frameworks) with strong engineering discipline.
  • Own complex technical work end-to-end: implementation, testing, deployment readiness, and production validation.
  • Drive high-quality code practices: reviews, refactoring, performance tuning, and technical debt management.


Technical leadership in partnership

  • Collaborate with Architects and Principal Engineers to align on technical direction, reference architectures, and platform standards.
  • Translate architectural direction into executable team-level designs: service boundaries, integration patterns, transactional consistency, and data-access strategy.
  • Lead technical discovery/spikes and propose pragmatic options with trade-offs.


Transactional systems & data engineering

  • Design for correctness and integrity using transactional databases (SQL, schema evolution, indexing, query performance).
  • Handle concurrency, consistency models, idempotency, and failure modes (retries, sagas/outbox patterns where applicable).
  • Ensure safe migrations and backward-compatible changes to data structures and service contracts.


Mentorship & team enablement

  • Mentor engineers through pairing, code reviews, design sessions, and technical coaching.
  • Raise team capability in Java engineering practices, distributed systems thinking, and operational hygiene.


Quality, reliability, and operability (“build it, run it”)

  • Embed robust testing aligned to service criticality working closely with Quality Assurance Engineers.
  • Partner with Performance Engineers and IT Operations to ensure operational readiness: monitoring, alerting, dashboards, runbooks, and production access patterns.
  • Participate in incident response as needed; work with the incident team on follow-ups (RCA actions, preventative fixes, resilience improvements).



What we’re looking for:


We are looking for a Technical Leader with solid experience in Java and related technologies.


  • Degree in Computer Science or equivalent field.
  • Professional software engineering experience, with substantial hands-on backend/service work.
  • Strong Java expertise and common ecosystem frameworks (e.g., Spring / similar) and build/test tooling.
  • Strong SQL and transactional DB fundamentals (modeling, migrations, performance, locking/concurrency implications).

  • Demonstrable ownership of production systems in a transactional domain.
  • Advanced English.
  • Clear communication and alignment skills across Architecture, Principal Engineers, Product, QA, NOC, and IT Ops.

title: Senior API Engineer (NodeJS, TS, SDUI)
description:
About the Company:

Headspace Health is the world’s most accessible and comprehensive digital mental health and wellbeing platform. Headspace Health will democratize mental health and wellbeing so people around the world are supported by a full spectrum of affordable care. In addition to its vast library of mindfulness and meditation content, our behavioral health system offers emotional support, guidance, therapy, and medication from professional coaches, licensed therapists, and psychiatrists, respectively.

Our mission is to create a world where mental health is never an obstacle. By harnessing the power and convenience of a smartphone, Headspace Health is able to provide access to high-quality care to anyone, anywhere, in order to reduce symptoms of stress, anxiety, and depression.


Role summary:

Lead the design and operation of APIs that power Server-Driven UI for Flutter clients while owning backend services across the stack. You’ll design stable UI contracts and compose client payloads, be comfortable diving into other backend codebases to implement features and fix production issues, participate in the on-call rotation to keep services healthy and low-latency, and drive team capability for SDUI.


Key responsibilities:

  • Design and implement robust RESTful APIs for SDUI, auth, and rate limiting.
  • Implement composition/templating logic that returns client-ready UI payloads with capability-aware fallbacks.
  • Champion SDUI capability across the team: coach engineers, run hands-on workshops, create onboarding/docs, and promote SDUI best practices.
  • Work across multiple backend repositories: add features, refactor, and maintain code quality.
  • Operate production services: own SLAs, alerting, runbooks, incident response, and participate in on-call rotation.
  • Improve reliability and performance (caching, CDN strategies, Redis, profiling, autoscaling, and load testing).
  • Build and maintain CI/CD, testing, and observability (metrics, tracing, logs, dashboards).
  • Integrate personalization, experimentation hooks, and feature flags into the delivery flow.
  • Collaborate closely with mobile/web teams to define contracts and client compatibility.
  • Mentor peers, lead design reviews, and drive API and schema governance and backward-compatibility practices.


Required skills & experience:

  • 7+ years building production microservices and APIs.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills, with active participation in team ceremonies and the ability to work effectively across engineering, product, and design.
  • Strong Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) experience, including effective use of abstraction and dependency injection patterns to build modular, testable, and maintainable backend systems.
  • Hands-on development in TypeScript for backend services.
  • Proven RESTful API design and contract experience.
  • Solid experience with databases and caching technologies, such as PostgreSQL, MySQL, and Redis, with an understanding of data modeling, query performance, and cache strategies.
  • Strong with AWS (API Gateway/Lambda or ECS/EC2, S3, CloudFront, RDS/ElastiCache or equivalents).
  • Experience with containerization using Docker (image build, Docker Compose, registries, running services in containers).
  • Strong testing experience, including automated testing and manual verification.
  • Experience with production support: alerting, runbooks, incident management, and on-call duties.
  • Familiar with CI/CD, automated testing, and observability tooling (Prometheus, OpenTelemetry, etc.).
  • Good spoken English


Nice to have:

  • Terraform or other IaC for managing AWS resources.
  • Experience instrumenting endpoints and surfacing behavior in analytics platforms such as Amplitude (event schemas, dashboards, alerts).
  • Experience using Statsig, Grafana, and Sentry for experimentation, dashboards, error tracking, and incident diagnostics.
  • Protobuf experience (service/event schema management via service-protos).
  • Background in personalization/experimentation systems.
  • Hands-on development in Python for backend services.


Hiring signals:

  • Examples of evolving APIs without breaking clients and measurable reliability/performance improvements.
  • Proven track record of mentoring and up-skilling engineers—especially enabling teams to adopt and own SDUI patterns.
  • Evidence of effective on-call ownership: resolved incidents, improved runbooks/alerts, postmortems.
  • Code that shows strong testing, observability, and cross-repo contributions.


Perks:

  • We welcome new ideas and allow you to make an immediate impact on the team
  • Health/Sport budget
  • Remote work
  • Flexible PTO
  • Global offices
  • Fun, positive, collaborative environment!



Kindly submit your application and CV in English.

title: Senior SRE/Platform Engineer (Python/Go)
description:
About the role

Skyflow is a data privacy vault delivered via APIs. It helps companies isolate, protect, govern, and use sensitive data such as personal, health, or payment information securely, without losing usability. It’s built on a zero-trust architecture, meaning no one gets access to data unless explicitly allowed.

Skyflow is looking for a Platform Engineer to support the SRE team and help design, build, and maintain scalable backend services and infrastructure. This role combines strong backend development skills with knowledge of SRE practices, contributing to the reliability, automation, and optimization of production systems. The Platform Engineer will collaborate closely with SREs, engineers, and business teams to ensure systems are performant, maintainable, and scalable.


Requirements

  • 5+ years of professional software engineering experience, with a strong focus on platform and infrastructure development
  • Experience supporting infrastructure, automation, or reliability practices (SRE exposure is a plus)
  • Proficiency in backend programming languages such as Python or Go
  • Familiarity with cloud platforms (AWS preferred)
  • Experience with containerization and orchestration tools such as Docker and Kubernetes
  • Knowledge of CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure as code (Terraform, CloudFormation), and automation
  • Hands-on experience with RDBMS and distributed systems
  • Ability to work collaboratively with SRE and engineering teams to support production systems
  • Understanding of application observability, monitoring, and performance best practices
  • Good spoken English


Responsibilities:

  • Develop automation and tooling to improve system monitoring, incident response, and operational efficiency.
  • Build and maintain infrastructure as code using IaC technologies like Terraform and CloudFormation.
  • Collaborate with engineering teams to design and implement scalable, fault-tolerant architectures.

  • Partner with developers to embed reliability and performance best practices throughout the development lifecycle.


We offer:

title: StarRocks Database Engineer (DBE) - Remote
description:
Database Engineer (DBE) – Enterprise Open-Source Support

Location : Remote (preferred South / Central America or US TIme Zones)

Department : Engineering - Open Source Database support

Reports to: CTO / VP Engineering


About Deep.BI

We provide enterprise support and consulting for open‑source analytics and data infrastructure platforms such as Apache Druid, Apache Flink, StarRocks and other emerging technologies.Our customers run mission‑critical, high‑volume systems and rely on us to keep them fast, stable, and available. We’re a small, world-class expert, remote‑first team working across multiple time zones (US, Brazil, Europe, India, Philippines), supporting 100+ customer environments with SLAs ranging from advisory support to 24/7 incident coverage.


Role Overview

As a Database Engineer (DBE), you will be the core L3/L4 technical expert responsible for solving the most complex database problems our customers face in production with an emphasis on supporting StarRocks clusters. You’ll dive deep into query optimization, ingestion pipelines, schema design, and HA/DR configuration — ensuring that large-scale analytical systems remain reliable, scalable, and performant.


While your primary focus is database internals and advanced troubleshooting, we value engineers with broader skills — knowledge of DevOps, Infrastructure, security or SRE Practices is highly appreciated and will make you even more impactful. 


Key Responsibilities

  • Advanced troubleshooting (L3/L4): Diagnose and resolve complex issues in StarRocks and other OLAP database clusters (performance Bottlenecks, ingestion failures, query regressions)
  • Performance optimization: Tune queries, schemas, ingestion flows, and configs to maximize efficiency under high load.
  • Architecture & design support: Work with Solution Architects to shape data models, indexing strategies, and HA/DR approaches.
  • Incident resolution under 24/7 SLA: Comfortable debugging under SLA pressure and participating in on-call rotations. Act as the escalation point for production incidents, ensuring rapid root cause analysis and fixes.
  • CVE patching: Apply, validate, and test security patches for database systems in customer environments.
  • Knowledge sharing: Document best practices, contribute to playbooks, and mentor junior engineers when needed.
  • Optional / nice-to-have:
  • Support deployments with DevOps engineers (Kubernetes, cloud, automation)
  • Assist in secure configuration and compliance requirements
  • Collaborate with developers (DD role) on upstream OSS bug fixes or feature contributions.


Requirements

  • 2+ years hands-on experience operating and troubleshooting StarRocks clusters in larger scale production (not just querying or dashboard usage; no PoCs) 
  • Proven experience with query optimization,indexing, schema design, and ingestion pipelines .
  • Solid knowledge of distributed systems concepts (consistency, replication, failover, scaling)
  • Hands-on experience with high availability and disaster recovery setups
  • Comfort with Linux systems, networking basics and SQL .
  • Ability to analyze logs, metrics, and configs under pressure (incident scenarios)
  • Strong English language communication skills — able to explain technical decisions clearly to engineers and delivery managers both verbally and in writing
  • Bonus: Experience with Apache Druid, ClickHouse, TiDB, Apache Cassandra, or similar databases
  • Bonus : Experience with Kubernetes, cloud infra (AWS/GCP/Azure), or security best practices (RBAC, encryption, IAM).
  • Bonus : Contributions to open-source database projects.


What we offer

  • Work with cutting-edge open-source technologies at enterprise scale .
  • Opportunity to collaborate with top engineers across databases, communities.
  • Competitive salary 
  • Support for conference travel and OSS contributions
  • Flexible contract structure (direct employment or via a global payroll partner or contractor/B2B), depending on your location and preference.


Location & working style

  • Remote‑first - we collaborate online across multiple time zones.
  • Role requires regular overlap with European and North American business hours.

Como saber se você é a pessoa certa para fazer parte da maior comunidade de professores independentes do Brasil?


Se você tem grandes ambições para impactar a educação no Brasil, acredita que o ensino de idiomas precisa de inovação, quer otimizar sua agenda de aulas e, ainda, gostaria de crescer como empreendedor, este é o lugar certo para você.

  • Possibilidade de participar em capacitações durante a semana, no turno da manhã ou tarde.
  • Independência para executar atividades, espírito de colaboração e vontade de contribuir para uma comunidade.


O diferencial?


Aqui você é mais que um professor.


Você será parte de uma comunidade de professores no ensino de idiomas , onde o trabalho colaborativo é a base para alcançar resultados de mercado altamente competitivos.


Esta não é uma vaga CLT , mas sim uma oportunidade de empreender e ser dono do seu crescimento com total suporte e estrutura de uma empresa inovadora.


Você cria laços e relações de confiança com pessoas que realmente se esforçam para te ajudar no seu desenvolvimento, devido ao modelo de negócio inovador que proporciona relações colaborativas e efetivas.


Se você tem vontade de fazer diferente e de vivenciar algo novo na sua história profissional, a ii com certeza é o seu lugar.


Faça parte da mudança no ensino de idiomas. Junte-se à Idioma Independente e transforme sua carreira e a vida de milhares de alunos!


O que eu faço?


  • Recebo capacitação para dar a melhor aula experimental da sua vida
  • Recebo capacitação em nossa metodologia, aprendendo como transformar a vida de muitos alunos, entregando resultado para eles/as

  • Dou as aulas para os meus alunos/as


Se você quiser ir além, também será possível, basta você se engajar na comunidade e aprender mais sobre todas as áreas do seu negócio.


QUANTO EU RECEBO POR ISSO?


  • Se você for somente professor, se dedicando 40h na semana a aulas, você poderá receber até R$4.000,00 por mês.
  • Se você quiser aprender sobre diferentes áreas e se engajar na comunidade, você pode construir uma renda mensal de até R$6.000,00 por mês em aproximadamente 1 ano.
  • Se você realmente quiser crescer e se desenvolver, se dedicando de forma integral junto da comunidade é possível chegar até R$12.000,00 por mês em 2 anos.


Tudo isso só dependerá de você, se quiser aprender mais sobre as partes comerciais e sobre como se tornar um mentor/a de professores.


Seja diferente, seja independente

title: Sr DevOps Engineer Azure (Remoto | PJ)
description:
100% Remote

USA Timezone

Role Overview

The goal is to shape the reliability and scalability of mission-critical platforms on Azure, Kubernetes , and modern DevOps toolchains. You will solve complex infrastructure challenges, automate end-to-end operations, and ensure systems operate with high availability, performance, and security.


What You Will Do

  • Design, build, and improve CI/CD pipelines for applications and infrastructure

Minimum Qualifications

  • Proven track record in SRE or DevOps roles operating production systems
  • Hands-on experience running production workloads on Kubernetes in a cloud environment, including cluster design, autoscaling, upgrades, and network policies.
  • Proven CI/CD delivery using GitHub Actions or Jenkins , including promotion across environments, approvals, and rollback strategies.

Plus

Full-Time | Brazil (Hybrid) | Mid–Senior Level


About the Role

We build technology products for companies that are reshaping how industries operate. Our design team sits at the intersection of product strategy, engineering, and user research, and the work we do ships to real users.


This is not a purely visual design role. Designers here influence product direction, collaborate closely with engineers and product leaders, and help define how complex systems should actually work.


We are looking for a UI/UX Designer who can move fluidly between ambiguous discovery work and pixel-precise execution. You will partner with product managers, engineers, and client stakeholders to design experiences that are strategically sound and deeply usable.


What You'll Do

• Own design end-to-end for one or more product workstreams, from research and wireframes through final developer handoff

• Facilitate discovery sessions with clients and internal teams to clarify problems before jumping into solutions

• Produce high-fidelity prototypes and detailed design specifications that engineers can build from with minimal iteration

• Conduct usability testing and translate insights into actionable design improvements

• Contribute to and help maintain shared design systems across multiple products

• Present design rationale clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders, including client leadership

• Collaborate with product managers to define success metrics for design decisions and evaluate outcomes after launch

What We're Looking For


Must-Have Experience

• 3+ years of product design experience, ideally within a startup, consultancy, or fast-paced product environment

• Strong portfolio demonstrating systems thinking and problem solving, not just visual design

• Advanced proficiency with Figma including components, auto-layout, variables, and interactive prototyping

• Experience designing for both web and mobile platforms with awareness of technical constraints

• Ability to communicate design decisions in terms of user impact and business value

• Comfortable working in ambiguous environments where problems are not fully defined


Nice to Have

• Experience designing products for enterprise or B2B users

• Familiarity with front-end development concepts such as HTML, CSS, or React fundamentals

• Experience with service design or end-to-end journey mapping for complex products

• Experience building or scaling a design system from the ground up


How We Work

Our teams operate in short delivery cycles with tight collaboration between design, product, and engineering. We prioritize fast decision making, direct communication, and high ownership.


We partner with organizations across industries including healthcare, financial services, logistics, and enterprise software. Projects range from building new products from scratch to modernizing complex legacy platforms.


What You'll Get

• Competitive base salary with performance-based compensation

• Comprehensive health, dental, and vision benefits

• Flexible remote-first environment with optional in-person collaboration

• Exposure to a wide range of industries and product challenges

• A design-focused team that values craft and pushes each other to produce exceptional work

Estamos ansiosos para conhecer você e, juntos, proporcionar uma experiência de aprendizado única para nossos alunos!

title: Digital Experience Solution Architect
description:
Join Toptal’s Elite Network of Freelance Talent

Toptal is an exclusive network of the world’s top freelance software developers, designers, finance experts, product managers, and project managers. As one of the fastest-growing fully remote networks globally, we empower professionals to thrive in their freelance careers while working with leading companies around the world.


About the Client

Our client is a global consumer goods leader dedicated to developing essential products, with a strong focus on innovation, sustainability, and responsible manufacturing.


Role: Digital Experience Solution Architect

Seeking an experienced Digital Experience Architect to lead the design and implementation of secure, scalable, and high-performing brand websites. This role drives technical strategy, personalization, and compliance across digital platforms while mentoring teams and fostering innovation.


About the Role

This is a high-impact role within a global consumer goods company, focused on modernizing digital brand experiences through MACH architecture and cloud-native solutions. The digital team is transitioning legacy platforms to composable, API-first environments to improve speed, performance, and personalization. Collaboration across marketing, legal, compliance, and engineering functions is essential to align technical architecture with business goals and regulatory standards. The team prioritizes innovation, sustainability, and inclusivity, with strong support for career development and hybrid work flexibility.


Task and Deliverables

  • Architect and implement scalable, secure digital solutions for global brand websites
  • Lead the transition to modern CMS systems using MACH principles (Microservices, API-first, Cloud-native, Headless)
  • Integrate personalization tools and performance optimization techniques to drive measurable business outcomes
  • Ensure compliance with global privacy regulations (CPRA/CCPA, GDPR) and lead consent and data protection architecture
  • Maintain architectural documentation including roadmaps, runbooks, and system diagrams.
  • Provide full-stack technical leadership across frontend (React) and backend systems
  • Guide teams on technology selection, architecture best practices, and compliance integration
  • Ensure uptime and reliability through proactive monitoring, incident response, and root cause analysis
  • Mentor team members, fostering a culture of technical excellence
  • Support legacy systems during phased migration to modern architecture


Requirements


Must Have:

  • 8+ years of experience in solution architecture for large-scale, consumer-facing digital platforms
  • Expertise in full-stack development (React frontend, CMS/backend, API-first integration)
  • Strong knowledge of MACH architecture and modern CMS platforms (headless and traditional)
  • Experience with Azure or AWS and cloud-native deployments
  • Strong understanding of relational databases, SQL, and web security best practices
  • Familiarity with containerization, composable architectures, and event-driven design


Nice to Have:

  • Experience with Customer Data Platforms (CDPs) and real-time personalization
  • Knowledge of identity resolution and event-based customer interaction flows
  • Exposure to eCommerce platforms and digital marketing technologies


Additional Details

  • Location: Remote in Brazil or Argentina
  • Type: 40h/week Contract
  • Duration: 6–12 months (with possibility of extension)
  • Authorization: Applicants must be authorized to work in their country of residence without employer sponsorship

title: Pessoa Cientista de Dados - Vaga afirmativa para pessoas LGBTQIAPN+
description:

Um ambiente de trabalho saudável é um lugar onde todas as vozes são ouvidas, respeitadas e valorizadas.

Ter cursado um curso de graduação em ciência de dados, aprendizado de máquina, matemática, ciência da computação, estatística, engenharia, economia ou uma área relacionada.

Por que você deveria se juntar a nós:

  • Artefact é o lugar para estar: venha e construa o futuro da área de dados.
  • Progresso: cada dia oferece novos desafios e novas oportunidades de aprender.
  • Cultura: Empatia e Colaboração está no nosso DNA.
  • Empreendedorismo: você se juntará a uma equipe de empreendedores motivados. Não desistiremos até que façamos uma grande diferença nesta indústria!

Junte-se a nós!

title: React Application Architect

You are an Application Architect specializing in marketing technology and digital analytics platforms.   • Own and optimize advanced Google Tag Manager configurations, including tags, triggers, variables, and structured data layers.
  • Govern tracking implementations across Google Analytics 4, Google Ads, and Facebook Pixel, including Conversions API integrations.
  • Design tracking solutions resilient to browser privacy restrictions and compliant with global privacy regulations.
  • Lead the transition from fragmented client-side tracking to robust server-side and API-driven architectures when appropriate.

  • Conduct regular audits to ensure data accuracy, attribution integrity, and alignment with business and marketing objectives.
  • Collaborate closely with marketing, analytics, and engineering teams to document requirements and implement new tracking solutions.
  • Optimize tracking implementations to protect and improve Core Web Vitals and overall site performance.
  • Develop and maintain technical documentation and architecture standards related to tracking, performance, and system reliability.


Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in application architecture or marketing technology roles.
  • 5+ years of experience with React.
  • Advanced experience with Google Tag Manager and Google Analytics 4.
  • Strong experience with Facebook Pixel and Conversions API.
  • Solid JavaScript knowledge for tracking implementations.


Additional Information

About Us


At Applaudo , we partner with ambitious companies to transform through technology with an AI-native mindset at the core of how we think, build, and deliver. We combine strategic clarity, world-class execution, and modern engineering practices to help clients accelerate measurable business outcomes and stay competitive.


We are building a high-performance culture grounded in five values: Empowering Excellence, Collaborative Teamwork, Unsolicited Respect, Consistent Transparency, and Efficient Communication. These define how we work, how we make decisions, and how we hold ourselves accountable.


Applaudo is a place for people who want to grow fast, take ownership, and work alongside strong teams. Joining us means being part of an organization that is evolving intentionally, investing in modern ways of working, and embracing AI as a lever for productivity, innovation, and impact.

title: Senior Content Manager
description:
As a Senior Content Manager, you will play a key role in supporting MoveUp Media’s growth by owning the operational and strategic execution of content across our website portfolio. You will take ownership of content performance and strategy across our websites, while leading day-to-day content operations and working closely with SEO and cross-functional teams. You will be responsible for turning content and SEO strategies into measurable results, while ensuring high-quality standards across multi-language teams and markets.


This role contributes directly to the CORE department’s objectives by supporting the growth, stability, and diversification of the business through content performance, strong processes, and effective collaboration. You will act as the main point of ownership for content quality and delivery, working closely with SEO, Product, and cross-functional teams.


To be more specific, you will:


  • Lead and develop the content strategy for our flagship, multi-language websites across multiple markets
  • Manage content workflows and ensure consistent, high-quality output across all sites
  • Oversee content quality, structure, and standards across our portfolio
  • Work proactively with content teams to define and implement content checklists and best practices
  • Collaborate closely with SEO, Tech, Design, and Product teams to ensure content and SEO best practices are followed
  • Ensure all SEO and content checks are completed ahead of website launches or redesigns
  • Regularly review websites to identify issues, suggest improvements, and support teams with implementation
  • Monitor content performance and report progress and key initiatives to senior stakeholders
  • Ensure content meets compliance and regulatory requirements and oversee necessary updates
  • Stay up to date with market trends, best practices, and iGaming innovations
  • Support hiring and team development (mentoring) in collaboration with Talent Acquisition and HR.


The ideal profile


We’re looking for a Senior Content Manager ready to step into a Lead role — someone who takes ownership of content performance, works independently, and collaborates closely with SEO to drive results.


You are someone who:


  • Has 3+ years of experience in a senior content or content leadership role
  • Has iGaming experience (a strong plus, not a must)
  • Has a background in journalism, communications, or a related field (a plus)
  • Has an excellent command of English and a strong eye for content quality and consistency
  • Is comfortable reviewing and optimising content rather than writing it


You bring strong CM fundamentals:


  • High level of autonomy and strong task prioritisation skills
  • Ownership mindset over site and content performance
  • Ability to analyse performance data and turn insights into clear actions
  • Strategic thinking and the ability to plan toward defined goals
  • Experience working with CMS platforms


You work well with others and think ahead:


  • Collaborative approach, especially when working with SEO teams
  • Proactive in sharing ideas, flagging issues, and suggesting improvements
  • Open to experimentation, innovation, and continuous improvement
  • Positive attitude with a growth mindset and leadership potential


Feeling up to the task of managing the main challenges of the role, even without meeting all criteria? We're eager to hear from you! We know not all great candidates will match 100% of the above.


Next steps in the process ✅


  • 1rst Interview with your future manager to make sure you meet the role’s requirements
  • 2nd interview with HR to better understand who you are and make sure there is a cultural fit with MoveUp Media
  • Last step: a proposition for us to start working together!


What’s in it for you


  • A full time remote work environment.
  • A flexible schedule and paid time off. We measure results , not hours.
  • Competitive salary, depending on your level of seniority in the role and your location
  • Development opportunities. As a startup with rapid growth, there are a lot of possibilities that can arise and we are committed to accompany our team members in their career path.
  • Yearly get together with the team to connect, work and have fun . We strive to find good spots for everyone to enjoy the stay!


MoveUp Media

title: SAP Basis Pleno com espanhol avançado
description:
Buscamos um(a) SAP Basis Pleno  com espanhol avançado  para atuar em Managed Services  e projetos  (assessment de performance, migração e otimização). O(a) profissional atuará em ambientes RISE/SAP S/4HANA  e on‑prem/híbridos , com forte interface com Infra de Banco de Dados (HANA, Sybase, Oracle)  e Cloud (GCP, Azure, AWS) .


Responsabilidades principais:

  • Sustentação (L2/L3)  de landscapes SAP (S/4HANA, ECC, BTP/integrações, Fiori), incluindo monitoramento , incident management , problem management  e changes  (janelas programadas).
  • Operação de DB/Infra : administração e troubleshooting de SAP HANA , SAP ASE/Sybase  e Oracle  (backup/restore, tunning, roles/segurança, housekeeping, BR*Tools, etc.).
  • Cloud  (GCP/Azure/AWS): suporte a arquiteturas SAP em nuvem (compute/storage/network), conexões seguras , sizing, troubleshooting de conectividade e serviços gerenciados.
  • Projetos técnicos :
  • Performance assessment  (end‑to‑end: app/server/DB), análise de traces, memória, I/O, jobs, RFCs.
  • Migrações/Upgrades  (blue/green/rolling), patching  de kernel/DB/OS, SAP Notes  e manutenções de rotina.
  • Otimizações : melhoria contínua (ajustes de parâmetros, automações, scripts, alertas).
  • Governança e documentação : execução de checklists , RCA  (5 porquês / Ishikawa), Hiper‑care pós‑mudança , documentação reutilizável e handover.
  • Colaboração cross : interação com PMO/SDM, times de segurança, redes, vendors/hyperscalers e SAP Support (OSS).


Requisitos obrigatórios:

  • Espanhol avançado  (reuniões e escrita). Português : avançado. Inglês : leitura técnica.
  • Experiência comprovada  em SAP Basis  em Managed Services  (operando múltiplos clientes/landscapes).
  • DB/Infra : HANA  (Studio/Cockpit, backup/restore, performance, roles), Sybase/ASE  e Oracle  (BR*Tools, RMAN, parâmetros, troubleshooting).
  • Cloud : experiências práticas com GCP  e/ou Azure  e/ou AWS  para workloads SAP (compute, storage, networking, IAM/segurança básica, conectividade híbrida).
  • Projetos : participação ativa em assessments de performance , migrações  (incl. OS/DB/KERNEL), upgrades  e patching .
  • Conhecimento de RISE with SAP  e ecossistema atual (S/4HANA, BTP, integração com hyperscalers).
  • Vivência com monitoramento  (ST03N/ST02/SM21/DBA Cockpit, etc.), transportes  (STMS), jobs  (SM37), spool  (SP01), locks  (SM12/DB), RFC  (SM59), notas SAP  (SNOTE).
  • Boas práticas de ITSM/ITIL , segurança  (perfis/autorização básicos), documentação  e runbooks .


Diferenciais:

  • Certificações : SAP Certified Technology Associate (S/4HANA, HANA), OS/DB Migration , especializações em hyperscalers  (Azure/AWS/GCP) e segurança .
  • Experiência com SAP Web Dispatcher , SAP Router , Solution Manager/ALM , Fiori , BTP  (connectivity, destinations), Cloud Connector .
  • Automação (scripts, pipelines, Infra as Code), observability (Dynatrace, Splunk, Grafana/Prometheus) e cost/performance optimization  em cloud.
  • Atuação prévia em War Rooms  e crise  (P1), com comunicação executiva.

title: Revenue Operations Associate
description:

YipitData is the leading market research and analytics firm for the disruptive economy and most recently raised $475M from The Carlyle Group at a valuation of over $1B. We operate globally with offices in the US (NYC, Austin, Miami, Mountain View), APAC (Hong Kong, Shanghai, Beijing, Guangzhou, Singapore), and India. YipitData isn’t a place for coasting—it’s a launchpad for ambitious, impact-driven professionals.

From day one, you’ll take the lead on meaningful work, accelerate your growth, and gain exposure that shapes careers.

  • Rapid Growth : We compress years of learning into months

If your ambition is matched by your work ethic—and you’re hungry for a place where growth, impact, and ownership are the norm—YipitData might be the opportunity you’ve been waiting for.

About The Role:

Are you a collaborative consulting, analytics, or operations professional with 3+ years of experience, passionate about building a world-class revenue team?

We are seeking a Revenue Operations Associate to play a crucial role in our fast-growing team, SpendHound. As a fast-growing “start-up” within a larger organization, this is a unique opportunity for someone with a strong operational mindset to come in and help build something truly special.


We expect East work hours.


As our Revenue Operations Associate, you will partner with our Sales and Marketing teams to:

  • Implement processes and solutions that can streamline revenue acquisition and eliminate inefficiencies
  • Maintain and measure various components of the Sales process, such as
  • Target/Territory Management
  • Lead Generation, and
  • Outbound Cadence Operations.

  • You have advanced Excel skills
  • Your experience with CRMs such as Salesforce.com
  • You are willing to become proficient in SQL and data management
  • You are a natural problem-solver, with a keen eye for detail and spotting issues
  • You are committed to continuously improving yourself and helping those around you


What We Offer:

  • Flexible PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits)
  • Flexible work schedule
  • Personal laptop
  • Health and wellness package
  • Remote work
  • Your growth at YipitData is determined by the impact that you are making, not by tenure, unnecessary facetime, or office politics. Everyone at YipitData is empowered to learn, self-improve, and master their skills in an environment focused on ownership, respect, and trust. See more on our high-impact, high-opportunity work environment above!

With our product, vacation rental managers can create a meshable WiFi guest network with a custom-branded WiFi login page that collects guest information. Our software lets them monitor their network remotely and integrates with their marketing tools to help them build relationships with their guests and grow their business.


Over the past 5 years, we’ve built our business from the ground up without the help of large investors. This means we’re growing a sustainable business and we run it independently. We hire globally and currently have a strong presence in the US, Latin America (Argentina, Brazil, Colombia), Europe (Netherlands, Portugal, Romania), and Africa (Egypt, Nigeria). title: Finance Business Partner | Accounts Receivable
description:
About Pinnacle Group

Pinnacle Group is a leading workforce solutions and technology services provider delivering innovative, results-driven solutions to global enterprises. With deep expertise in financial operations, staffing models, and program management, we help organizations optimize performance while maintaining strong compliance and operational excellence. Our finance team plays a critical role in supporting scalable growth, operational efficiency, and exceptional client experiences across diverse programs.


Summary

The Finance Business Partner will lead Pinnacle Group’s Accounts Receivable operations while serving as a strategic advisor to client-facing business teams. This role is approximately 70% operational, overseeing billing, collections, reconciliations, supplier payments, and team performance, and 30% focused on financial partnership and business support. The ideal candidate will bring strong leadership, analytical expertise, and a client-service mindset to improve AR performance and drive financial excellence. This position is instrumental in ensuring accurate cash flow management, client satisfaction, and continuous process improvement.


Job Description


Accounts Receivable Management

  • Oversee the full AR lifecycle including invoicing, collections, reconciliations, dispute resolution, and aging analysis.
  • Ensure accurate and timely billing while resolving client exceptions efficiently.
  • Monitor client payments, oversee cash application, and ensure timely settlement reconciliation to support 100% on-time supplier payment SLAs.
  • Partner with Accounts Payable and Treasury to align receivables with cash flow forecasts and payment schedules.
  • Monitor receivables aging and collaborate with client stakeholders and PMO teams to resolve payment inquiries.
  • Manage quarterly client and supplier volume rebates with precision and compliance.
  • Standardize AR policies, procedures, and playbooks across programs while maintaining audit readiness and strong internal controls.
  • Drive automation and continuous improvement initiatives to enhance AR efficiency and scalability.


Finance Business Partnering

  • Serve as the primary finance liaison to program leaders and account managers, supporting invoice-related issue resolution.
  • Provide actionable insights on billing behaviors, dispute trends, and invoicing challenges to improve program performance.
  • Present tailored AR reporting to leadership, highlighting risks, opportunities, and business impact.
  • Support onboarding of new client programs with structured billing guidance and financial playbooks.
  • Collaborate with Legal and Contracts to align billing terms and resolve disputes effectively.
  • Handle sensitive financial matters with discretion, urgency, and professionalism.


Team Management & Development

  • Lead and mentor a team of 2–4 AR analysts across onshore and offshore locations.
  • Manage hiring, training, workload distribution, and performance management in coordination with leadership.
  • Track and analyze AR KPIs including on-time billing, payment application, supplier payment SLAs, and resolution timelines.
  • Foster a culture of accountability, innovation, and proactive problem-solving.
  • Design and implement development plans to enhance team autonomy and operational excellence.


Technology & Systems

  • Manage AR modules within Workday and collaborate on system enhancements and integrations.
  • Review testing outcomes for system updates and approve AR-related production releases.
  • Contribute to the AR technology roadmap to support automation and process optimization initiatives.


Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Business, or related field.
  • Minimum 5 years of management experience in Accounts Receivable or related financial operations.
  • Strong knowledge of US GAAP and accounting principles.
  • Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel including pivot tables, VLOOKUPs, and data analysis.
  • Experience with Workday or other ERP/accounting systems.
  • Experience in the staffing industry or Pay-When-Paid programs preferred.
  • Proven leadership experience managing diverse teams and driving measurable performance improvements.
  • Excellent communication skills with the ability to translate financial data into business insights.


Why Join Pinnacle Group?

At Pinnacle Group, you will play a strategic role in shaping financial operations that directly impact business growth and client success. We foster a collaborative, high-performance culture where innovation, accountability, and continuous improvement are valued. This role offers significant visibility across business leadership, opportunities to influence process transformation, and the ability to build and develop a strong finance team. If you are driven by operational excellence and strategic impact, Pinnacle Group offers a platform to grow your leadership career.

title: Auxiliar de loja

Nacionalmente contamos com +2.000 pontos de venda, além de termos nossa matriz corporativa presente na cidade de São Paulo, e contarmos com 2 centros de distribuição: um em Cotia/SP, e outro em Serra/ES.

Nosso propósito é “impulsionar a moda para o bem”, além de termos como visão “sermos a marca de fashion lifestyle mais admirada do mundo!”. Para isso, temos alguns valores como individualidade, integridade, paixão, parceria e responsabilidade.

Além disso, a CK é conhecida por seu grande compromisso com Diversidade e Inclusão! Todas as nossas vagas são direcionadas a todos os públicos, valorizando a pluralidade de identidades e experiências. Por isso, incentivamos a candidatura de pessoas negras, LGBTQIAPN+, pessoas com deficiência, indígenas, de diferentes gerações, e outros tipos de diversidade. Aqui, você é uma pessoa bem-vinda para ser quem é (lembra do nosso valor de #individualidade? =D)!

Como será seu dia a dia aqui:

Reportando-se ao Gerente de Loja, sua principal responsabilidade será prestar suporte geral a loja, com atendimento em caixa, apoio aos vendedores, controles administrativos, organização de estoque, possibilitando uma boa experiência do cliente em visita e consumo da loja, além do controle e organização seguindo os procedimentos e as políticas internas da CK.

Além disso você também será responsável por:

  • Processar as vendas de produtos no momento da compra do cliente, ofertando produtos adicionais para a venda agregada no caixa;
  • Dar suporte aos vendedores durante o atendimento aos clientes, acompanhando necessidades de busca de produtos, verificando se o cliente precisa de algum apoio, oferecendo conforto e acolhimento com café, água, guarda de volumes e demais condições disponíveis pela loja.
  • Manter os produtos da loja alarmados, repostos, precificados, controlados e passados, verificando as necessidades de arrumação de estoque, araras, gavetas, frente de loja e demais locais de exposição ou armazenamento de produtos, efetuando ou acompanhando contagens de inventário, movimentando os itens quando necessário e respeitando os padrões e orientações tanto de Visual Merchandising quanto da liderança imediata.

title: CRO & Shopify Developer
description:
CRO & Shopify Developer

  • Full time contractor
  • £22-32k per year (depending on experience).
  • Bonus structure on performance


About PM Digital

PM Digital is The full-funnel CRO & Performance agency for 7, 8, and 9-figure DTC brands. We optimise & fix entire funnels. Our focus is increasing profitability for ecommerce brands and you are part of this through the CRO split testing and Shopify development for our client stores.


About the Role

We're looking for a CRO & Shopify Developer to join one of our pods. You'll work alongside CRO strategists, designers, and copywriters to build high-converting landing pages, implement A/B tests, and bring Figma designs to life in Shopify.

This isn't a \"fix bugs and update plugins\" role. You'll be building conversion-focused pages from scratch, implementing split tests, and directly impacting revenue for DTC brands spending serious money on paid acquisition.


What You'll Do

  • Build landing pages, PDPs, and funnel pages in Shopify based on Figma designs
  • Implement A/B and multivariate tests using Convert.com and Intelligems
  • Set up price testing, offer testing, and bundle experiments via Intelligems
  • Work within our internal app and processes to ship work on time
  • Translate designer and strategist intent into pixel-perfect, fast-loading pages
  • Ensure all builds are mobile-first, performance-optimised, and QA'd before launch
  • Collaborate daily with your pod (CRO strategist, designer, copywriter)
  • Flag technical limitations or opportunities early — don't wait until it's a problem
  • Document your work clearly so others can maintain and iterate on it


What We're Looking For

  • 3+ years Shopify development experience (themes, Liquid, custom sections)
  • ADVANCED use of AI Within your development workflow. Speed is key.
  • Strong HTML, CSS, JavaScript — you can build from scratch, not just edit templates
  • Experience turning Figma designs into production-ready Shopify pages
  • Familiarity with A/B testing platforms (Intelligems, Convert.com, or similar)
  • Understanding of page speed optimisation and Core Web Vitals
  • Comfortable working async in a remote team across time zones
  • Strong written communication, you'll be working with non-developers daily
  • Attention to detail, sloppy work doesn't ship
  • Strong AI Use case to speed up time to delivery


What Success Looks Like

  • Pages go live on time, match the design, and perform well
  • Tests are implemented correctly the first time — no re-work loops
  • You proactively flag issues and suggest better solutions
  • Your pod trusts you to execute without hand-holding


You'll Thrive Here If You:

  • Want ownership, not tickets
  • Care about the outcome (revenue), not just the output (code)
  • Move fast and communicate clearly
  • Take pride in clean, maintainable work
  • Want to grow with a high-performance team


You Won't Thrive Here If You:

  • Need constant direction or detailed specs for every task
  • See QA as someone else's problem
  • Struggle with direct feedback
  • Don't hit deadlines


Details

  • Remote (European time zone based)
  • Full-time contractor
  • Salary based on experience - £22-34k BOE


How to Apply

Send a short note on why this role fits you, plus:

  • Link to 2-3 Shopify websites or experiences you've built (landing pages or custom work preferred)
  • Brief explanation of a test you implemented and how it performed (if applicable)


Fill in this form after the job role, you will get all your information here.


DON'T USE AI FOR QUESTIONS AND ANSWERS -

title: Manager, Corporate Development
description:
Manager, Corporate Development at Healthcare Head Office


Perseus Group is a major Operating Group of Constellation Software (csisoftware.com | TSX:CSU), a Canadian-based publicly held company. Perseus Group has over 6,000 employees, across 70+ software business units, operating in 12+ software industry verticals, located in over 40 offices.


The Role

Perseus is growing the Business Development team within our M&A group. This role will be primarily focused on covering the Brazilian software market. The successful candidate must be based in Brazil.

The role is to build strong strategic business relationships that lead to the sourcing of current and future M&A opportunities for Perseus. Relationships will be formed with decision makers (i.e. CEOs/VPs of Corporate Development/founders/owners) of software companies globally, M&A advisors, and private equity/venture capital professionals. Success is defined by building and maintaining meaningful relationships, having clients sign LOI’s and ultimately, the acquisition of software companies/assets by Perseus/Constellation.

Initiating relationships, maintaining relationships, and ultimately being considered and chosen to be acquired by Perseus/Constellation typically takes multiple years. Measurable outcomes, continuous value-add through many M&A conversations/relationships and high-quality market research is what ultimately generates successful acquisitions through time.


Outcomes:

  • Develop and manage an M&A pipeline through Salesforce CRM and create market maps to build strong relationships in assigned software industry vertical(s)
  • Meet and exceed monthly M&A targets, such as meaningful contacts and other measurable M&A sourcing KPIs.
  • Work both autonomously and with M&A leadership to qualify M&A opportunities with efficiency
  • Ensure the lead database is allocated accurately within portfolio verticals
  • Effectively qualify opportunities at the top-end of the acquisition funnel to maintain focus for the Portfolio Managers of the business units.
  • Have a meaningful impact on Perseus Group over a successful tenure in-role


Relevant Experience & Competencies:

  • Experience in a Business Development/Sales position at a software company or client-facing M&A/finance role within business development, sales, and/or account management. Preference for experience in outbound-focused origination roles.
  • A clear interest in developing a long-term pipeline of meaningful relationships with prospects as a career trajectory within software investing.
  • Previous high-performance in Business Development, winning in an autonomous role or, prior success in other walks of life outside professional BD experience, such as entrepreneurship, will be considered.
  • Advanced verbal and written communication skills, with the confidence and executive presence to speak with CEOs, M&A advisors, corporate development, private equity and venture capital professionals.
  • Organized, detail oriented, and able to work variable hours.
  • Extraordinary work ethic, proactive with a sense of urgency.
  • Full fluency in Portuguese and at least professional-level fluency in English are required, Spanish fluency is a plus.
  • This role will require occasional in-person travel and can be primarily performed either Remotely within Brazil or from a Hybrid-Sao Paolo, Brazil office.

O cargo combina excelência técnica em Data Science com forte entendimento de mídia, metodologia e negócio, atuando como elo entre Dados, Produto, Operações e áreas comerciais, garantindo que o dado seja consistente, confiável, relevante e acionável para o mercado.

  • Conduzir análises aprofundadas de dados para identificar padrões, tendências, anomalias, riscos metodológicos e oportunidades de melhoria nos produtos, processos e entregas.
  • Desenvolver e testar hipóteses de negócio por meio de abordagens quantitativas, apoiando decisões estratégicas e táticas.
  • Atuar como consultor interno para as áreas de Produto, Operações, Taxonomia, Comercial e Liderança, traduzindo dados complexos em recomendações claras e acionáveis.
  • Automatizar análises, relatórios e fluxos de dados, aumentando eficiência operacional, escalabilidade e confiabilidade das entregas.
  • Monitorar continuamente a qualidade, cobertura e consistência dos dados, identificando e investigando desvios, gaps e comportamentos atípicos.
  • Contribuir para a evolução do conhecimento analítico e metodológico da empresa, por meio de documentação, treinamentos, apresentações e troca ativa com outros times.
  • Participar de interações com clientes e fornecedores quando necessário, explicando metodologias, análises e implicações dos dados de forma clara e transparente.

Conhecimento Essencial:

  • Forte experiência em análise de dados, modelagem estatística e Data Science.
  • Domínio de Python e/ou R e SQL.
  • Inglês avançado.
  • Experiência com ferramentas de visualização (Power BI, Tableau ou similares).
  • Experiência com grandes volumes de dados e pipelines analíticos.
  • Capacidade de traduzir problemas de negócio em problemas analíticos e vice-versa.
  • Comunicação clara, didática e colaborativa.



Conhecimento Desejável:

  • Conhecimento de ambientes de cloud (AWS, Azure ou GCP).
  • Familiaridade com metodologias ágeis.
  • Conhecimento específico de mídia digital, cross-media, CTV, VOD.
  • Entendimento de mídia, publicidade e métricas de investimento (ou capacidade de aprender rapidamente).
  • Conhecimento de banco relacional e databricks.




O que oferecemos?

title: Automotive Project/Release Manager
description:
Project Description:

This role coordinates delivery and releases for an in-car accessibility product within an Android-based infotainment system, with a primary focus on meeting legal and regulatory accessibility requirements.


Core responsibilities include ensuring compliance, traceability, and correct implementation of accessibility-related changes, while driving quality improvements, defect resolution, and predictable, disciplined releases. Occasional support for new feature development is also expected.

Due to the nature of accessibility work, even small changes can have significant user and legal impact, making precision, validation, and strong execution essential. The role operates in a highly complex stakeholder environment, where stakeholders are typically hands-off during day-to-day execution but become highly involved and escalatory when issues arise. Successfully navigating these situations—through transparency, risk anticipation, sound judgment, and resolution under pressure—is a critical aspect of the role.

The role works closely with a small team of Android developers. The exact split of responsibilities will be defined once the new hire is onboarded, allowing flexibility based on individual strengths, experience, and evolving product and delivery needs.


Responsibilities:

Product & Backlog Management

• Manage and maintain the product backlog in Jira, with a primary focus on accessibility-related bug

fixes, improvements, and release work

• Support new accessibility features by preparing, refining, and tracking requirements and acceptance

criteria with stakeholder

• Clarify functional, UX, and accessibility requirements with stakeholders and engineering

• Ensure backlog items are well-defined, testable, and ready for implementation


Sprint, PI & Delivery Execution

• Plan and facilitate sprint and PI activities with the development team

• Coordinate sprint planning, reviews, retrospectives, and execution tracking

• Monitor progress, dependencies, and risks across sprints and PIs

• Sequence and balance work within agreed priorities and constraints to support timely delivery


Accessibility, Quality & Change Coordination

• Coordinate defect fixes, accessibility improvements, and change requests

• Assess and document impacts, dependencies, and delivery risks, especially where accessibility or

compliance may be affected

• Highlight trade-offs and potential impacts early and transparently

• Escalate complex or high-impact topics to the appropriate stakeholders

Release & Operational Ownership

• Coordinate end-to-end release activities, including readiness tracking, validation status, and

communication

• Support CI/CD, build, test, and deployment processes in collaboration with engineering

• Track release quality, regression risks, and production issues

• Coordinate verification activities on test benches and organize debugging sessions when required

• Management of test specifications (update existing test specifications if required, create test runs for

external testers, etc.)


Stakeholder Communication

• Represent the team and topic in stakeholder meetings, like calls with VW Group brands or

representatives of legal and regulatory departments

• Act as the primary coordination point for day-to-day delivery and release topics

• Communicate progress, risks, and release status clearly and consistently

• Support alignment between product, UX, engineering, and validation stakeholders


Mandatory Skills Description:

Product & Delivery Execution

• Proven experience in Product Owner, Technical Program Manager, Delivery Lead or Release Engineer roles

• Strong ability to manage end-to-end delivery in a complex, cross-functional environment

• Experience managing multiple release timelines

• Hands-on experience with backlog management, refinement, and sprint execution

• Ability to sequence and coordinate work within agreed priorities


Quality & Compliance Mindset

• Experience working with quality-critical or compliance-driven requirements

• Strong attention to detail and traceability (requirements → implementation → validation)

• Ability to manage high-risk changes where small defects can have large impact


Release & Operational Skills

• Experience coordinating software releases end to end

• Ability to track release readiness, risks, and regressions

• Comfort working with production or preproduction environments (e.g. test benches)


Tools & Ways of Working

• Experience working with distributed or nearshore teams

• Strong hands-on experience with Jira and Confluence

• Solid understanding of agile software development (Scrum, SAFe)

• Ability to operate independently with limited guidance


Stakeholder & Pressure Handling

• Proven ability to work with hands-off stakeholders who escalate under failure

• Strong communication skills: clear, calm, and structured under pressure

• Ability to anticipate issues, surface risks early, and drive resolution

• Good judgment in knowing when to act independently vs when to escalate


Nice-to-Have Skills Description:

Domain & Platform Experience

• Experience with automotive software or infotainment systems

• Familiarity with Android Automotive or embedded platforms

• Exposure to in-car UX, HMI, or accessibility topics


Accessibility & UX Awareness

• Experience with accessibility, usability, or inclusive design

• Familiarity with accessibility standards or legal requirements (any domain)


Advanced Release / Engineering Exposure

• Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines, build, test, and deployment processes

• Release engineering or DevOps collaboration experience

• Experience supporting stabilization, bugfix-heavy, or late-stage products

• Experience coordinating cross-team dependencies


Environment & Collaboration

• Comfort operating across time zones

• Experience in environments with high expectations and low tolerance for failure


Tools & Ways of Working

• Experience in requirements & test case

management in CodeBeamer
