title: Senior Full-Stack Mobile Engineer (React Native)
description:
This role requires deep, verified React Native experience. If your background is primarily React web, native iOS/Android, or backend-only, this is not the right fit.


FlyMeOut is a profitable, invite-only social travel network growing over 160% year-over-year. We run a highly selective social travel platform — and we're moving fast and expanding offerings in 2026.


We're not pre-revenue. We're not burning cash. We're growing, and we need a senior full-stack mobile engineer who can ship production React Native features on day one.


What you'll build: You'll lead development across our React Native mobile app (Expo, TypeScript, TanStack Query, Zustand) and work with our existing Node.js/TypeScript backend. The work is technically interesting — complex booking flows across yacht charters and villa rentals, payment orchestration with Stripe and Apple Pay, real-time features, and third-party API integrations. This isn't maintenance. You're shipping features that users interact with immediately.


Day to day, you'll be working on things like:

  • Designing and building new features end-to-end in React Native with TypeScript
  • Architecting booking and payment flows across multiple travel verticals
  • Integrating with payment platforms (Stripe, Apple Pay) and partner reservation APIs
  • Working with Firebase for auth, real-time data, and push notifications
  • Collaborating directly with the founder on product direction and technical decisions
  • Code reviews and mentoring a mid-level React Native engineer on the team


You should have:

  • 5+ years shipping production React Native apps (not React web — we will verify this)
  • Strong experience with Expo, TypeScript, and modern state management (TanStack Query, Zustand, or similar)
  • Backend capability with Node.js — you can work with and extend our existing API layer
  • Hands-on experience integrating third-party APIs, especially payment processors
  • Comfort working independently in a small team where you own the outcome


Nice to have:

  • Experience with travel tech, hospitality, or marketplace platforms
  • Familiarity with booking/reservation systems
  • Experience leading or mentoring other engineers
  • Apple Pay integration experience


Why FlyMeOut:

  • Profitable company with real revenue — not a cash-burning startup hoping for a runway extension
  • Growing 160%+ year-over-year with a planned fundraise in summer 2026
  • Fully remote — we hire across Latin America and work on overlapping timezones
  • Lean team, big ownership — your input directly shapes the product
  • Expanding into yacht charters, villa rentals, and restaurant reservations — you'd be building these from the ground up
  • Work directly with the founder on product and technical direction


Compensation & Terms

This is a full-time remote contractor position paid as a flat monthly rate via Wise.

Salary range: $60,000–$84,000/year ($5,000–$7,000/month)

Time off: 2 weeks PTO (flexible)

Health benefits: Not offered at this stage

Equity: Discussed on a case-by-case basis

Probation: 2 weeks

Core collaboration hours: 7:00 AM–2:00 PM PST | 12:00 PM–7:00 PM Brasil


How to Apply

Send your resume to with the subject line FMO-RN-2026 . In the body of your email, name one React Native app you have shipped that is currently live on the App Store or Google Play. Applications without this subject line will not be reviewed.

title: Technical Account Manager
description:
Technical Account Manager – Telecom Software


Iquall es una compañía de software especializada en automatización y transformación de redes para operadores de telecomunicaciones. Trabajamos con grandes carriers, ayudándolos a modernizar su operación, automatizar procesos críticos y evolucionar la gestión de la red hacia modelos más eficientes y autónomos. Somos una empresa con fuerte ADN técnico, pero con visión comercial y foco en crecimiento sostenible. Nuestro modelo combina coherencia comercial, credibilidad técnica y ejecución sólida.


Buscamos un Technical Account Manager (TAM) con fuerte perfil estratégico y orientación al cliente para gestionar cuentas clave (Tier-1) dentro del sector telecom. El TAM es responsable de gestionar integralmente la cuenta desde lo técnico-comercial. No es un rol de soporte ni de delivery operativo. Es quien entiende los desafíos del cliente, influye en su planificación futura y construye oportunidades sostenibles. El rol combina visión técnica, desarrollo de negocio y acompañamiento post-venta para asegurar la generación de valor continuo y la adopción de nuestras soluciones de automatización.


Principales Responsabilidades

Gestión Estratégica y Desarrollo de Negocio:

  • Comprender la estructura tecnológica, operativa y presupuestaria del cliente, alineando nuestras soluciones con sus iniciativas de transformación digital y eficiencia operativa.
  • Detectar iniciativas y problemas estructurales antes de que se conviertan en procesos formales de licitación (RFPs).
  • Generar proactivamente oportunidades de upselling y cross-selling sobre la base instalada (\"budget fishing\").
  • Influir en la planificación futura y las líneas presupuestarias del cliente.

Venta Consultiva (Soluciones Estándar):

  • Diseñar y presentar de forma autónoma propuestas técnico-comerciales cuando la solución se base en el portafolio existente de Iquall.
  • Traducir capacidades complejas de producto en soluciones claras, viables y con sentido económico para el cliente.

Relacionamiento y Evangelización:

  • Construir vínculos sólidos y gestionar múltiples stakeholders dentro de organizaciones complejas, manteniendo credibilidad tanto frente a equipos de ingeniería/operativos como áreas ejecutivas (C-Level).
  • Orquestar workshops y sesiones ejecutivas (\"Overview Demos\") para mostrar el arte de lo posible e impulsar la adopción de nuevas funcionalidades.
  • Continuidad Post-Venta (Value Delivery):
  • Asegurar la correcta implementación y adopción de las soluciones vendidas.
  • Coordinar la transición hacia la ejecución junto a los Project Managers (PMs) y Delivery, identificando riesgos tempranos, pero sin gestionar la operación directamente.


Requisitos Excluyentes:

ALLOS é uma marca com uma forte herança. São cerca de 50 anos de experiência, transformando o mercado no Brasil. Somos referência em excelência e inovação, com a qualidade e confiança que faz parte da nossa história.

A nova marca surgiu pronta para o futuro, a partir da fusão entre a Aliansce Sonae e a brMalls, em 2023. Mas, essa trajetória começou bem antes.

Tudo começou com a Aliansce, que inaugurou o primeiro shopping da região Nordeste e o segundo do Brasil em 1975. Em 2019, a fusão entre a Aliansce e a Sonae Sierra deu origem à Aliansce Sonae, tornando-se líder na administração de shoppings no Brasil, com 32 empreendimentos. Em 2006, surge a brMalls resultando em um portfólio de 30 ativos presentes nas cinco regiões do país.

E assim, em 2023, a ALLOS surge com o encontro de duas potências nacionais do segmento, unindo forças para se tornar a mais inovadora plataforma de entretenimento, lifestyle, serviços e compras.

Nossa história continua e estamos prontos para criar momentos que transformam e impactam a vida das pessoas, gerando conexões e oportunidades.

title: Software Engineer
description:
Software Engineer (LLM & AI Integration)


As a Software Engineer specializing in LLM Integration, you’ll be responsible for owning our AI infrastructure, agentic workflows, and the integration of Large Language Models into our core product. You’ll design and implement end-to-end AI features that empower our users and internal teams to leverage generative intelligence. You will maintain a scalable production environment using frameworks like LangChain or LlamaIndex and ensure that model outputs are accurate, secure, and performant. This role is perfect for someone who combines traditional software engineering rigor with a passion for the evolving AI landscape.


What You'll Do

AI Infrastructure & LLM Development

  • Design, build, and maintain reliable services that interface with LLMs (OpenAI, Anthropic, or open-source models).
  • Implement Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines to ground model responses in proprietary data.
  • Build and optimize backend APIs and microservices to support AI-driven features.
  • Develop robust prompt engineering strategies and evaluation frameworks to ensure output quality.
  • Document AI system architecture, model versioning, and integration patterns.

Product Integration & Collaboration

  • Collaborate with Product, Design, and Engineering teams to define user-facing AI capabilities.
  • Translate complex business requirements into technical AI solutions (e.g., automated support, intelligent search, or content generation).
  • Optimize model latency and token usage for cost-effective and snappy user experiences.
  • Support front-end teams in delivering seamless AI interactions.

Data Engineering for AI

  • Write and optimize SQL queries and vector database schemas (e.g., Pinecone, Weaviate, or Milvus).
  • Implement data preprocessing and embedding pipelines to prepare unstructured data for LLM consumption.
  • Establish best practices for fine-tuning models or managing few-shot learning datasets.
  • Monitoring & AI Ops
  • Monitor LLM performance, \"hallucination\" rates, and API health proactively.
  • Implement guardrails, moderation layers, and validation processes for AI safety.
  • Maintain CI/CD pipelines for AI services and manage model deployments.
  • Stay updated on the latest research in NLP, LLM orchestration, and agentic frameworks.


What You'll Bring

  • 3–5 years of professional experience in Software Engineering, Backend Development, or AI/ML Engineering.
  • Strong Python proficiency, specifically in building scalable backend systems and working with asynchronous programming.
  • Hands-on experience with LLM frameworks such as LangChain, LlamaIndex, or Haystack.
  • Solid understanding of RAG architectures, vector databases, and embedding techniques.
  • Proven ability to work with RESTful APIs and Cloud Infrastructure (AWS, GCP, or Azure).
  • Experience collaborating with cross-functional teams to ship production-grade software features.


Key Skills

  • Problem Solver: Analytical thinker who can debug complex, non-deterministic AI behaviors.
  • Communicator: Excellent skills for explaining technical AI constraints to non-technical stakeholders.
  • Self-Starter: Ability to take ownership of the AI roadmap in a fast-paced environment.
  • Detail-Oriented: Commitment to software craftsmanship, code quality, and AI safety.


Nice to Have

  • Advanced experience with Vector Databases (Pinecone, Chroma, Qdrant).
  • Familiarity with LLM Evaluation tools (Ragas, TruLens, or LangSmith).
  • Experience with deployment orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes, or Serverless functions).
  • Knowledge of fine-tuning techniques and libraries like Hugging Face transformers or peft.
  • Prior work in a startup environment where rapid prototyping and iteration are key.


Why Join Us?

You’ll play a critical role in defining our AI strategy from the ground up. We offer a flexible, fully remote work environment where you’ll have the autonomy to choose the best tools for the job and make a massive impact on our product’s evolution. Your work will directly define how our customers interact with the next generation of intelligent software.

title: Specialist AI Engineer / Builder (LLM & Healthcare) | 100% Remoto
description:
O DESAFIO:

A cada ano, o setor de saúde perde bilhões por falhas no faturamento. Nós somos o elo perdido que resolve esse gap com IA. Estamos em plena expansão , com operações reais, clientes ativos e novos parceiros no pipeline. Buscamos um Builder para transformar nosso produto atual em uma plataforma de escala global.


POR QUE ESTA POSIÇÃO É PARA VOCÊ?

Aqui, autonomia, responsabilidade e protagonismo são nossa vivência diária. Não buscamos pessoas prontas; não saber tudo faz parte do processo. O que valorizamos é a curiosidade investigativa e o desejo genuíno de aprender.


Você atuará do operacional ao estratégico : da mão no código à tomada de decisão. É o perfil que propõe novos modelos e identifica oportunidades de receita, mas que também valida dados manualmente para garantir que a solução seja impecável. Atitude, velocidade e senso de urgência são os motores que impulsionam nossa entrega.


PRINCIPAIS RESPONSABILIDADES:

Sua missão é liderar a transição tecnológica da nossa inteligência:


• O Agora (Execução e Precisão):

  • Refinar e otimizar modelos em produção (AWS Bedrock), elevando constantemente os níveis de acurácia e performance.
  • Garantir precisão absoluta \"batendo\" dados e regras manualmente; em saúde, a qualidade do dado é inegociável.
  • Monitorar padrões de negativas (denials) e implementar loops de correção imediatos para que o sistema aprenda em tempo real.


• O Futuro (Escala e Arquitetura):

  • Evoluir nossa infraestrutura para um ecossistema robusto de RAGs e bancos vetoriais .
  • Migrar de uma solução centralizada para uma malha de modelos especializados por contexto e seguradora.
  • Contribuir para o fine-tuning de modelos próprios , utilizando nossos dados históricos para criar uma vantagem competitiva única.


O QUE BUSCAMOS:

  • Curiosidade Investigativa: Desejo genuíno de aprender e decifrar as regras complexas do faturamento médico. Você não precisa vir da saúde, mas precisa querer dominá-la.
  • Atitude e Senso de Urgência: Valorizamos a velocidade e a proatividade. Em nosso contexto de negócio, a capacidade de entrega rápida é vital.
  • Mão no Código: Experiência prática sólida com Python ou Go e APIs de LLM (OpenAI, Anthropic, Bedrock).
  • Mentalidade de Builder: Capacidade de construir sistemas robustos do zero e obsessão pelo detalhe (não descansa enquanto a automação não reflete a regra de negócio com precisão cirúrgica).


O QUE OFERECEMOS

  • Oportunidade em Estágio Inicial: Chance de ser um dos primeiros membros de uma empresa em rápida expansão, com impacto direto na arquitetura e cultura.
  • Desafio Técnico de Alto Nível: Resolver problemas reais usando o estado da arte em IA Generativa.
  • Equipe de alto nível: você encontrará pessoas fora da curva e nada melhor do que trabalhar com pessoas assim, né?
  • Flexibilidade e Futuro: Trabalho 100% remoto com possibilidade de participação societária (Equity ) para quem constrói o negócio conosco.
  • Legado: você deixará o seu nome na construção, nos códigos e na história da empresa.

title: Viral Video Scout
description:
Turn Your Love of Viral Videos Into Income


Freelance Viral Video Scout (Remote – Global)


Company: Caters Media Group


Payment: Fixed fee per signed video


About Us

Caters Media Group is a leading international multimedia agency specialising in sourcing and licensing compelling video content to major global media outlets. We work with broadcasters, publishers and digital platforms around the world — and we’re always looking for the next viral moment before it hits the mainstream.

Many of our most successful scouts are people who already spend time discovering trending videos online. If you regularly spot viral moments before they explode across the internet, this could be an opportunity to turn that instinct into income.


The Opportunity

We are looking for motivated, self-driven individuals to join our global network of freelance Viral Video Scouts.

Your role will involve identifying compelling real-life videos online and helping us connect with the original creators so the content can be licensed to global media outlets.


Your responsibilities include:

Discover viral, newsworthy or emotionally compelling videos

Identify and verify the original creator of the content

Introduce creators to the opportunity to have their video licensed through Caters Media Group

Build rapport and, where required, speak with creators via phone or video call to explain how licensing works

Help secure signed agreements allowing Caters Media Group to represent the video

You earn a fixed fee for every video you successfully introduce that results in a signed licensing agreement.


No targets.

No fixed hours.

Work from anywhere.

Work when you want.


How It Works

You complete initial training with our team

We teach you what makes video content commercially valuable

We guide you on verifying ownership and introducing creators to the licensing opportunity

After training, you work independently identifying opportunities


You receive a fixed payment for each successfully signed video.


Your earnings depend on both the number of videos you secure and the quality and suitability of those submissions for licensing.


A fixed fee is paid once a creator has signed a licensing agreement with Caters Media Group for a video you introduced, and the video meets our internal quality and editorial guidelines.


All video submissions and creator agreements are subject to verification and approval by Caters Media Group before payment is issued.


This role is offered on an independent freelance basis and does not constitute employment with Caters Media Group.


What We’re Looking For

You don’t need formal qualifications — but you do need:

A sharp eye for viral and newsworthy video content

Confidence communicating with content creators

A strong standard of spoken and written English

The ability to speak with creators via phone or video call to explain licensing opportunities clearly and professionally

Self-motivation and initiative

Good time management


This role is ideal for people who:

Follow trending videos across multiple platforms daily

Enjoy spotting viral moments before they reach mainstream media

Understand the difference between original footage and reposted content

Enjoy identifying compelling real-life stories and moments

Are comfortable communicating with new people

Want flexible earning potential alongside other commitments

Are budding journalists interested in developing their news sense and editorial instincts

Work in journalism, media, or content creation and are looking to generate additional income alongside their existing work

If you regularly spot videos before they reach major news outlets, this role could be a strong fit.


  What This Is (And Isn’t)


✅ Flexible freelance opportunity 

✅ Fixed fee per signed video

✅ Work from anywhere

✅ Initial training provided

✅ No fixed hours

✅ No minimum targets

❌ Not a salaried role

❌ No guaranteed income

❌ Not suited to those uncomfortable speaking with creators directly


Important

Due to the high number of applications we receive, only candidates who follow the application instructions carefully and complete the example task will be considered.

Applications that do not meet the requirements below may not be reviewed.


Application Requirements

All applications must be submitted in English.

Please include the following:

Attach your CV / Resume in English

Tell us which social media platforms you use most frequently

Explain why you believe you would be good at identifying licensable video content

Example Video Task

Please provide one example of a recent viral video that you believe could generate licensing revenue.

The video must:

Be posted on the social media account of the original video owner (the person who filmed the content)

Have been posted within the last 24 hours

Include a direct link to the video

Along with the link, please include 2–3 sentences explaining why you believe the video has licensing potential.

Ownership Check - In one or two sentences, explain how you have determined that the person posting the video is the original owner of the footage.

To confirm you have read the full application instructions, please include the word “Scout” in the subject line of your application email.

title: Research Engineer, RL Environments
description:
About Turing

Turing builds large-scale datasets and reinforcement learning (RL) environments that power post-training for the world's leading AI labs and enterprises, including OpenAI, Anthropic, Google DeepMind, Microsoft AI, Amazon, Apple, and many more. We create RL environments to evaluate and improve our customers' models on complex, multi-step workflows across high-value domains — designing the tasks, reward signals, and verifiers that drive measurable model improvement through RL training.


The Role

We are looking for a Research Engineer, RL Environments to help design and build frontier-quality RL environments, reward systems, and evaluations that improve state-of-the-art models for leading AI labs and enterprise clients.

This is a hands-on, research-facing technical role. You will work directly with customer researchers and engineers to translate their post-training and RL goals into concrete environment specs — designing tasks with verifiable outcomes, building reward and verifier systems, and ensuring environments are robust against reward hacking and distribution collapse.


We're targeting candidates with roughly 4–5 years of experience building deep learning or RL systems — especially where strong results depended on environment design, reward engineering, training infrastructure, or rigorous evaluation.


What You'll Do:

1. Design and build RL environments and verifier systems

  • Work with customer researchers to translate RL training goals into environment specs: target capabilities, task distributions, difficulty curves, and success criteria.
  • Design task suites with verifiable outcomes — single-step and long-horizon workflows with clear ground-truth signals.
  • Build reward functions, verifiers, automatic validators, and evaluation harnesses that provide reliable training signal and resist gaming.
  • Define environment interfaces: APIs, tool schemas, state abstractions, database schemas, and simulator-like dynamics that give agents realistic constraints.


2. Build quality systems that keep environments robust at scale

  • Audit environments and trajectories for subtle failure modes: reward hacking, leakage, ambiguity, distribution shifts, and degenerate task distributions.
  • Implement automated validation: deduplication, decontamination, consistency checks, difficulty controls, and diversity monitoring.
  • Develop synthetic task generation and augmentation pipelines: programmatic generators, controlled perturbations, hard negatives, and scenario templating with diversity constraints.


3. Prove impact through evaluations and training runs

  • Design and run evals reflecting customer-intended model capabilities.
  • Produce analysis connecting environment design choices to training outcomes: pre/post comparisons, error breakdowns, and ablations identifying which environment and reward attributes drive model lift.
  • When needed, run RL or fine-tuning experiments (or partner with research) to validate that your environments produce measurable improvement.


4. Collaborate with cross-functional delivery teams

  • Provide clear specs, examples, and edge cases to engineers, domain SMEs, and data production groups.
  • Run fast feedback loops based on trajectory analysis and quantitative signals.
  • Review and improve outputs from large-scale task and environment creation efforts.


Who We're Looking For:

1. Required Qualifications

  • 4–5 years of experience building or improving deep learning or RL systems where environment design, data quality, or reward engineering mattered materially.
  • Hands-on experience with reinforcement learning — any of: environment/gym development, reward design, PPO/GRPO/DPO, trajectory collection, or RL training infrastructure.
  • Strong intuition for what makes a good training task: verifiability, appropriate difficulty, resistance to shortcuts, and realistic constraints.
  • Demonstrated ability to be extremely detail-oriented in diagnosing subtle quality issues and failure modes in data or environments.
  • Python proficiency required; comfort with SQL and structured data workflows strongly preferred.
  • Ability to communicate clearly with researchers and engineers — turning RL training objectives into concrete environment specs.


2. Highly valued experience

  • Post-training experience: RLHF/RLAIF, verifier training, reward modeling, or constitutional AI methods.
  • Experience building custom gym environments, simulators, or distributed RL training systems.
  • Agentic evaluation: tool use, multi-step workflows, long-horizon tasks, trajectory analysis.
  • Systems thinking: ability to simulate an application's API and data schema and design tasks reflecting real-world constraints.
  • Experience with LLM fine-tuning at scale.


Why Turing

  • Work directly with the world's leading AI labs on the RL environments powering post-training for frontier models.
  • Real impact: your environments and reward systems will directly shape how models learn to reason, act, and improve.
  • Talent-dense team with high autonomy, rapid iteration, and an exceptional learning curve.


Values:

  • We are client first : We put our clients at the center of everything we do, because their success is the ultimate measure of our value.
  • We work at Start-Up Speed: We move fast, stay agile and favor action because momentum is the foundation of perfection
  • We are Al forward: We help our clients build the future of Al and implement it in our own roles and workflow to amplify productivity.


Advantages of joining Turing:

  • Amazing work culture (Super collaborative & supportive work environment; 5 days a week)
  • Awesome colleagues (Surround yourself with top talent from Meta, Google, etc. as well as people with deep startup experience)
  • Competitive compensation
  • Flexible working hours


Don’t meet every single requirement?

Studies have shown that women and people of color are less likely to apply to jobs unless they meet every single qualification. Turing is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, protected veteran status, or any other legally protected characteristics. At Turing we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive and authentic workplace and celebrate authenticity, so if you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyways. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.


For applicants from the European Union, please review Turing's GDPR notice here.

title: Elementor Expert (WordPress Website Builder)
description:
We are looking for a skilled WordPress developer with strong Elementor experience to join our team and build high-performance websites for our marketing agency clients.


This role focuses on executing a proven build process , not designing sites from scratch. You’ll work from established Elementor Pro templates while inserting pre-generated content and images created by our internal AI systems.


If you enjoy working within clear systems and take pride in building clean, fast, and polished websites , this role will be a great fit.



Responsibilities


  • Build 3–4 WordPress websites per week using pre-built Elementor Pro templates
  • Insert AI-generated content into website layouts (all content is provided)
  • Adjust layouts and design elements to tailor each template for the client
  • Generate website visuals using AI image tools based on supplied prompts
  • Create simple design assets when needed using Canva
  • Integrate WooCommerce functionality for ecommerce websites
  • Ensure each website achieves extremely fast page load speeds (under 1 second)
  • Follow documented build processes and workflows precisely



Required Skills & Experience


  • Advanced proficiency with Elementor and Elementor Pro
  • Strong knowledge of WordPress performance optimization
  • Experience configuring WooCommerce within Elementor websites
  • Familiarity with AI image generation tools (Midjourney, DALL-E, OpenAI, etc.)
  • Basic graphic design ability and experience with Canva
  • Strong English communication skills
  • Available during EST business hours
  • Highly organized and comfortable working within defined processes



What This Role Focuses On


This role is about efficiently producing high-quality websites using a repeatable system .


You will not be responsible for writing content or designing full websites from scratch. Our automation tools generate the text and provide prompts for images. Your job is to assemble the site using templates, produce visuals, refine the layout, and ensure the final result is clean, professional, and extremely fast.



Important Note


⚡ Performance is critical.

Every site must achieve full page load speeds under 1 second without relying on caching solutions.


If you do not have strong experience optimizing WordPress for speed, this role will not be a good fit.



What We Provide


  • Managed hosting accounts
  • Elementor Pro licenses
  • AI-generated content for every site
  • Image prompts for generating visuals
  • Detailed documentation and build processes
  • A steady pipeline of website projects


Full-time role

Working hours: 9:00 AM – 5:00 PM EST (±1 hour flexibility)



Who We’re Looking For


The ideal candidate is detail-oriented, efficient, and process-driven . You take pride in producing polished work, enjoy following clear systems, and understand how small optimizations can dramatically impact website performance.


You’re comfortable using modern tools like AI image generators, you work quickly without sacrificing quality, and you care about delivering websites that are both visually clean and technically fast .

• Contribuições em InnerSource/open source, publicações e talks em comunidades técnicas.

title: Investment Banking Intern
description:
Investment Banking Internship - WSO Global Talent Program

Our Global Talent Program offers an unparalleled opportunity to gain hands-on experience and build a formidable resume through an immersive, 10-week virtual internship.


We are actively screening thousands of top students globally to identify future finance leaders. This highly selective program is offered in partnership with leading boutique investment banks in key markets, including the US, UK, APAC, Europe, MENA markets.


Only two students are selected per quarter for this off-cycle, ongoing program, ensuring a focused and high-impact experience for our interns per geographic region.


What You'll Gain:

  • Intensive Financial Training (Weeks 1-2): The internship kicks off with two weeks of rigorous, in-house virtual training led by industry experts. You'll gain a strong foundation in core investment banking skills, including:
  • 3-Statement Financial Modeling
  • Discounted Cash Flow (DCF) Analysis
  • Trading Comparables (Comps)
  • Precedent Transactions
  • Advanced Excel & PowerPoint techniques
  • Industry Research & Sourcing Strategies
  • Real-World Experience (Weeks 3-10): Following successful completion of the initial training and assessments, you'll be introduced to a Managing Director or Partner at one of our boutique investment bank partners. For the next eight weeks, you'll work directly on live projects, providing invaluable support with:
  • Pitch Book Development
  • Valuation Analysis (Comps, DCFs)
  • Financial Modeling
  • Sourcing & Due Diligence
  • Industry and Company Research
  • And other critical tasks to support ongoing deals.
  • Mentorship & Feedback: Our partner firms are committed to providing a structured learning environment with a minimum of one 30-minute weekly call for deliverables, feedback, and guidance. This ensures you're actively engaged and continuously developing.


This is an unpaid internship designed for high-potential students seeking practical experience and a significant resume boost. The value lies in the rigorous training, direct exposure to real investment banking work, and the mentorship from experienced professionals.


Who We're Looking For:

This program is ideal for highly motivated 1st year and 2nd year students (not limited to) who are eager to get a head start in investment banking and build a compelling CV. We seek candidates who are hungry, quick learners, and committed to excelling in a fast-paced environment.


How to Apply:

Get your application in now! If selected, you will be invited to complete a short assessment. Top candidates from this assessment will move forward to the intensive training phase.

This is your chance to gain an unparalleled edge in your finance career. We look forward to reviewing your application!

title: Principal Technical Support Engineer (Remote)
description:
In our 'always on' world, we believe it's essential to have a genuine connection with the work you do.


We are excited to announce that we are hiring a Principal Technical Support Engineer in working from Brazil remotely to join our team and provide high‑level technical expertise to our Ruckus Premium (BullDog) customers.


Your primary responsibility is to serve as a key technical resource, delivering expert assistance and ensuring prompt resolution of complex customer issues.


How You'll Help Us Connect the World:


You work directly with customers to troubleshoot problems, isolate root causes, and drive cases to closure with a high level of technical accuracy and professionalism. When needed, you reproduce customer scenarios in the Support Lab to validate findings and deepen understanding of the issue.

You collaborate closely with Engineering teams to manage escalations, resolve product bugs, and ensure that long-term corrective actions are identified and implemented. Throughout each case, you provide consistent updates to sales teams, internal management, and customers, maintaining clear communication and transparency at every stage.


Given the nature of the role, you are expected to support a staggered work week when required (such as Sunday through Thursday or Tuesday through Saturday) and participate in a rotating on-call schedule. Flexibility in work hours is essential to accommodate urgent customer needs. You thoroughly document customer interactions, engineering engagements, and action plans to ensure high-quality case management and knowledge continuity.


Beyond case handling, you contribute to the organization by creating and refining knowledge articles, troubleshooting guides, and internal training materials. You provide mentoring and coaching to team members to help strengthen overall team capability. You also participate regularly in customer and internal conference calls for high-profile cases and escalations, ensuring issues receive appropriate visibility. All responsibilities are carried out with strict adherence to Service Level Agreement KPIs.


Required Qualifications for Consideration:


  • 8+ years of experience working in the networking space
  • 5+ years of experience working in a TAC
  • Excellent written and oral communication ability, including formal presentation skills to customers, partners, Ruckus accounts and support teams
  • Excellent understanding and applied knowledge of TCP/IP, L3 routing, L2 switching, Multicast, firewalls, QOS
  • Solid understanding and troubleshooting skills with wireless technologies 802.11x, WLAN authentication, encryption, EAP, PSK, Radius, AAA, DNS
  • Expertise of wireless deployments – AP’s, Controllers, Client associations, etc
  • Excellent understanding of RF transmission and antenna behavior
  • Technical expertise in troubleshooting and resolving complex Layer 2/3 and/or wireless issues in multi-vendor environments
  • Experience providing support to direct customers, resellers, and field personnel in resolving company product related issues
  • Ability to provide technical guidance to other members in the team
  • Experience working in a support lab environment for problem replication
  • Experience documenting the sequence of events related to resolving customer technical issues
  • Proficient with analyzing data traces from protocol analyzers such as Wireshark
  • High level of English.
  • Available Monday through Friday or ‘staggered work week’s, i.e. Sunday through Thursday or Tuesday through Saturday and weekend or overnight hours as required.




Important Candidate Notice : On January 9, 2026, CommScope finalized the sale of its Connectivity and Cable Solutions segment, which included the CommScope name and brand, to Amphenol Corporation. The remaining businesses — Access Networks Solutions (now rebranded as Aurora Networks ) and RUCKUS Networks have been unified under the new parent company, renamed as Vistance Networks . The role being advertised is part of RUCKUS Networks.


Why Join Us?

Vistance Networks shapes the future of communications technology, pushing past what is possible. We deliver solutions that bring reliability and performance to a world always in motion. Our global team of innovators and employees are trusted advisors who listen to customers first, then deliver value.


RUCKUS Networks delivers purpose-driven enterprise networks that enable superior business outcomes in demanding environments. Our solutions combine AI-powered automation, proactive network assurance, and context-aware security, providing exceptional performance with simplified management.


If you want to grow your career alongside bright, passionate, and caring people who strive to create what's next…..come connect to your future at Vistance Networks.


Vistance Networks is an Equal Opportunity Employer (EEO), including people with disabilities and veterans.

title: Senior DevOps Engineer / Architect
description:
Senior DevOps Engineer / Architect


Location: Remote (Brazil)



About Sphise Technologies


Sphise Technologies is a global outsourcing and talent solutions company, partnering with high-growth businesses to build strong, high-impact teams across finance, technology, and operations. Our trusted technology partner is scaling a modern cloud platform and is seeking a Senior DevOps Engineer / Architect to lead infrastructure strategy and DevOps practices. As the platform continues to grow, this role will be instrumental in building scalable cloud infrastructure, strengthening CI/CD pipelines, and ensuring the platform remains secure, reliable, and cost-efficient.


Position Overview


We are looking for a Senior DevOps Engineer or Architect who will take ownership of infrastructure-as-code, CI/CD pipelines, and cloud operations. You will play a critical role in ensuring the platform is scalable, secure, and reliable while optimizing performance and cloud cost efficiency.

This position requires a hands-on technical leader who can collaborate closely with engineering, security, and product teams while mentoring developers on DevOps culture and tooling.



What You'll Do:


  • Design, build, and maintain infrastructure using Terraform , ensuring reproducible and version-controlled environments.
  • Own and manage Azure cloud infrastructure including networking, compute, storage, identity, and platform services.
  • Architect and maintain CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions for applications built with .NET, PHP, Node.js, React, and Next.js.
  • Implement best practices in pipeline automation, testing integration, artifact management, and deployment workflows .
  • Strengthen platform security by implementing IAM best practices, secrets management, network segmentation, and encryption strategies .
  • Integrate security scanning tools (SAST/DAST/SCA) and compliance checks into infrastructure and deployment pipelines.
  • Build and maintain observability using DataDog and SolarWinds , including monitoring, logging, dashboards, and alerts.
  • Define reliability standards including SLOs, SLIs, and incident response runbooks .
  • Optimize cloud infrastructure costs through resource tagging, autoscaling strategies, reserved capacity planning, and cost monitoring dashboards .
  • Collaborate with engineering teams to promote DevOps culture, automation, and self-service capabilities .



What You Bring:


  • 5+ years of experience in DevOps, Platform Engineering, or Site Reliability Engineering.
  • Strong hands-on experience with Microsoft Azure cloud infrastructure .
  • Deep expertise with Terraform and infrastructure-as-code practices .
  • Proven experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions .
  • Strong understanding of cloud security practices , including IAM, secrets management, and vulnerability scanning.
  • Experience with Cloudflare services such as CDN, WAF, DNS, and Zero Trust.
  • Strong Linux administration and scripting experience (Bash, Python, or PowerShell ).
  • Experience working with SQL Server in cloud environments .
  • Hands-on experience with monitoring and observability tools such as DataDog or SolarWinds .
  • Strong communication and documentation skills.



Nice to Have

  • Experience with AWS infrastructure such as EC2, S3, RDS, IAM, EKS, or Lambda.
  • Experience with Databricks or modern data platform infrastructure .
  • Familiarity with policy-as-code frameworks such as OPA, Sentinel, or Azure Policy.
  • Experience working with Docker, Kubernetes, Helm, or container security practices .
  • Knowledge of FinOps practices and cloud cost optimization strategies .
  • Experience implementing SRE methodologies such as SLOs and error budgets .



What We Offer:

  • Competitive compensation package aligned with senior-level expertise.
  • Fully remote work environment with flexible collaboration across global teams.
  • The opportunity to shape and lead the DevOps architecture of a growing cloud platform.
  • Work with modern cloud technologies and engineering best practices .
  • A collaborative, engineering-focused culture with high ownership and impact .
  • Opportunities for professional development, certifications, and technical growth .

CLT, salário a combinar+ benefícios.

100% remoto.

title: Forensic Manager
description:
This leading multinational group, with significant operations across the Americas and worldwide, is seeking an experienced Forensic Manager to lead a team of corporate investigators across their regional operations.


Based in Belo Horizonte, you will be responsible for managing a team of forensic specialists who are overseeing investigations into complex financial crimes, including conflict-of-interest, procurement fraud, misappropriation of assets, corruption, and bribery.


Your role will be primarily focused on team leadership, setting key performance objectives, and building strategic relationships to ensure seamless regional operations. You will have day-to-day responsibility for managing forensic specialists, providing career development guidance, and overseeing resource allocation. Furthermore, you will serve as the primary point of contact for operational management while playing a key role in the overall strategic management of the group’s investigative objectives.


In addition to your leadership duties, you will undertake high-level corporate investigation projects, conduct fraud awareness training, and oversee the integration of data analytics into investigative workflows.


To be successful in this role, you should possess extensive experience in leading complex corporate investigations and managing specialized forensic teams. You are likely currently working in a managerial capacity within a forensic advisory firm or a comparable corporate business.


While a CFE qualification is highly welcomed, we value your proven ability to lead high-performance teams and manage senior stakeholder relationships. Excellent communication skills are essential, and candidates must be fluent in both Portuguese and English. Proficiency in Spanish and experience with advanced data analytics tools are welcomed.

title: Latam-focused research intern
description:

Recognized for its excellence and ethical commitment, the company offers innovative and effective services to meet the needs of clients around the world.
  Workplace: Rio de Janeiro, 100% on-site Contract Type: Internship   Position Description We are looking for a motivated and curious Research Intern to join our Research team, with a focus on Latin America’s, particularly Argentina’s, macroeconomic and financial environment . This position is ideal for students who are eager to learn and develop their skills in economic and financial research. The selected candidate must be native or fluent in Spanish and English (mandatory) and will support the research team in conducting studies, preparing financial reports, and assisting senior analysts in day-to-day activities.

· Assist in preparing summaries and basic analyses of market trends, economic projections, and corporate earnings.
· Help monitor economic events, public policy changes, and macroeconomic data that may impact financial markets.
· Track the performance and movements of financial assets.
· Assist in the development of financial models for company valuation, under the guidance of senior analysts.
· Support data collection, organization, and basic analysis.
· Assist with administrative and operational tasks such as organizing meetings, reports, and presentation materials.

· Clear and structured written communication skills.
· Willingness to learn, curiosity about financial markets, and interest in economic trends and global events.
 
Differentials · Previous internship or academic experience in finance, economics, or capital markets.
· Familiarity with financial information platforms such as Bloomberg or Reuters.
· Knowledge of basic programming or data analysis tools (e.g., Python, VBA, Power BI).
 
Benefits · Hands-on learning experience in a global company with a strong presence in the fixed income market.
· Exposure to macroeconomic analysis, company research, and financial markets in Lat Am.

· Collaborative, dynamic, and supportive work environment.

title: Java fullstack developer (angular)
description:
About You
You are a software engineer who enjoys building robust, scalable, and well-structured applications. You’re motivated by clean architecture, modern technologies, and meaningful collaboration across backend and frontend layers. You’re looking for a place where you can grow professionally, influence technical decisions, and contribute to high-impact products used by real customers.

Bachelor’s degree or higher in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field.
6+ years of professional experience developing backend solutions using Java (21+) and Spring Boot.
Strong experience building and maintaining monolithic backend applications following clean architecture principles.
Hands-on experience with Postgre SQL and in-memory data stores such as Redis.
Proven experience working with AWS services, including S3, ECS, Cloud Watch, and Bedrock.
Experience using My Batis as an ORM and Liquibase for database versioning and migrations.
2+ years of professional experience with Angular (v19 or similar), with strong usage of Rx JS and Observables.
Familiarity with frontend monolith architectures and modern client-side frameworks.
Advanced knowledge of Git and version control best practices.
Advanced English proficiency is required, as you will work directly with US-based clients.
You Will Be Accountable for the Following Responsibilities:
Participate in collaborative concept definition, architectural refinement, and software design across backend and frontend layers.
Design, build, and maintain scalable monolithic applications using Java 21 and Spring Boot.
Develop and maintain RESTful APIs and integrate them with Angular frontend applications using Rx JS and Observables.
Implement and manage data persistence using Postgre SQL, My Batis, Liquibase, and Redis.
Work with AWS infrastructure services (S3, ECS, Cloud Watch, Bedrock) to support application deployment, monitoring, and observability.
Follow Agile practices, working independently while collaborating closely with a cross-functional team.
Maintain high-quality technical documentation throughout the SDLC.
Qualifications
Hands-on experience with: Java 21, Spring Boot, Postgre SQL, Redis, Monolithic architecture design and development, AWS (S3, ECS, Cloud Watch), Angular (v19 or similar), Rx JS / Observables, My Batis and Liquibase.
Strong communication skills in English and Spanish.
Additional Information
About Us
At Applaudo , we partner with ambitious companies to transform through technology with an AI-native mindset at the core of how we think, build, and deliver. We combine strategic clarity, world-class execution, and modern engineering practices to help clients accelerate measurable business outcomes and stay competitive.
We are building a high-performance culture grounded in five values: Empowering Excellence, Collaborative Teamwork, Unsolicited Respect, Consistent Transparency, and Efficient Communication. These define how we work, how we make decisions, and how we hold ourselves accountable.
Applaudo is a place for people who want to grow fast, take ownership, and work alongside strong teams. Joining us means being part of an organization that is evolving intentionally, investing in modern ways of working, and embracing AI as a lever for productivity, innovation, and impact.

Como parte da equipe Schindler, você descobrirá um trabalho significativo que melhora a qualidade de vida das comunidades e contribui para tornar os locais mais acessíveis, inclusivos e sustentáveis para todos. Fabricamos, instalamos, modernizamos e prestamos o melhor serviço de manutenção para elevadores, escadas e esteiras rolantes. Somos líderes do segmento de mobilidade urbana no Brasil, e procuramos para trabalhar com a gente pessoas alinhadas aos nossos valores, que promovam um ótimo ambiente de trabalho para colegas e realizem um serviço excepcional aos clientes.

Participação nos Lucros e Resultados;

title: Analista de validação de processo
description:
1. Planejar, coordenar e executar estudos de validação de processos de fabricação. Elaborar protocolos, relatórios e análises críticas para suportar a reprodutibilidade e consistência do processo.
2. Desenvolver e executar protocolos de validação de limpeza para assegurar a remoção eficaz de resíduos e evitar a contaminação cruzada. Determinar os limites de aceitação de acordo com os requisitos de boas práticas de fabricação (GMP).
3. Planejar e conduzir validações de filtração esterilizante, incluindo testes de integridade, adsorção e retenção bacteriana para garantir a eficácia dos filtros utilizados nos processos de esterilização.
4. Realizar estudos de tempo de espera (holding time) para determinar e validar os tempos máximos permitidos entre as etapas críticas de produção, garantindo a manutenção da qualidade e esterilidade dos produtos.
5. Elaborar, revisar e aprovar protocolos, relatórios de validação de envase asséptico e outros documentos técnicos. Garantir a integridade e a rastreabilidade de todos os registros, em conformidade com as exigências regulamentares e padrões internos.
6. Atuar como referência técnica em processos de validação durante auditorias internas e externas, incluindo inspeções de autoridades sanitárias e auditorias de clientes.
7. Participação ativa em investigações de desvios, propondo ações corretivas e preventivas;
8. Elaborar apresentações e treinamentos referentes às atividades sob sua responsabilidade.
9. Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com equipes de qualidade, produção, engenharia e desenvolvimento, para a implementação de melhorias contínuas nos processos validados e o suporte técnico necessário em projetos e mudanças.
10. Participação da elaboração de URS (User Requirements Specification) para definição de novos projetos ou alteração de projetos já existentes.

title: Nurse offshore
description:
Position: Nurse Offshore
Location: FPSO Marechal Duque de Caxias
About Us
MISC Group is a world-leading provider of international energy-related maritime solutions and services.
For over 56 years, we have built a dynamic, progressive, and innovative global brand, delivering the highest standards of maritime services and creating sustainable value for our stakeholders worldwide.
Job Purpose
The Offshore Nurse is responsible for leading onboard health services, ensuring hospital readiness, providing medical assistance, and promoting a healthy working environment and overall wellbeing for all personnel onboard the FPSO. The role also ensures compliance with corporate health standards and applicable regulations.
Key Responsibilities
Lead onboard health services, ensuring hospital readiness and proper medical assistance at all times;
Activate MEDEVAC procedures in accordance with remote medical support instructions;
Maintain updated inventory of medicines and medical supplies, ensuring availability and preventing expired items onboard;
Liaise with onshore remote medical support for diagnosis guidance and prescription of medicines for injured or ill personnel;
Support the preparation and implementation of rescue plans (confined space and working at height);
Request calibration, hydrostatic testing, and replacement of hospital equipment and first aid kits to ensure prompt emergency response;
Inspect catering services and facilities, including food storage, conservation, preparation, and accommodation cleanliness, maintaining proper health inspection records;
Participate in auditing and certification processes related to health services;
Collect and monitor fresh and potable water samples, conducting analysis onboard and coordinating onshore testing in accordance with procedures;
Provide First Aid training to designated first aid teams onboard;
Prepare and maintain medical documentation and reports (Health Initial Report, Logbook, corporate reports, and other required documents);
Implement and maintain the Health Service Waste Management Program and ensure proper recordkeeping.
Requirements
Degree in Nursing with valid COREN registration;
Previous experience in offshore operations (FPSO or oil & gas environment preferred);
Advanced life support and emergency care training;
Experience with occupational health routines and health surveillance;
Fluent English (minimum intermediate level);
Strong organizational skills and ability to work independently onboard;
Knowledge of Brazilian maritime and health regulations is an advantage.
Benefits
Meal and food allowances
Bradesco Health Insurance (extended to family members at no cost, with no co-pay)
Life Insurance
Annual Bonus
Private Pension Plan
Childcare Allowance
Note
This position is open exclusively to Brazilian citizens.
MISC is committed to diversity and inclusion and welcomes applications from professionals of all backgrounds.

title: Senior azure cloud architect
description:
About You
You are a senior-level Azure Cloud Architect who enjoys building secure, scalable, and automated cloud platforms. You take ownership of architectural decisions and are comfortable translating business and platform requirements into repeatable Azure foundations. You value clean design, governance, and automation, and you collaborate closely with application, Dev Ops, security, and infrastructure teams.

5+ years of hands-on experience architecting and operating solutions in Microsoft Azure.
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, IT, or equivalent professional experience.
Proven experience implementing Microsoft Cloud Adoption Framework (CAF) and Azure Landing Zones.
Strong hands-on expertise with Terraform, including modular design and remote state management.
Experience designing enterprise Azure architectures, including multi-subscription environments.
Strong experience with Azure Dev Ops, including YAML pipelines and CI/CD governance.
Solid experience designing hub-and-spoke network architectures and hybrid connectivity.
Hands-on experience with Docker and Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS).
Strong understanding of cloud security, governance, and enterprise-scale architecture.
Experience implementing Azure security controls, RBAC, policies, and compliance standards.
Strong problem-solving skills and clear technical communication.
Azure certifications (AZ-305, AZ-400, AZ-104, AZ-204) and/or Terraform certification (nice to have).
Advanced English proficiency is required, as you will work directly with US-based clients.
You Will Be Accountable for the Following Responsibilities:
Design and implement Azure tenant architectures aligned with Microsoft Cloud Adoption Framework and Azure Landing Zone best practices.
Define and manage management group hierarchies, subscription strategies, and environment separation.
Establish standardized patterns for identity, networking, security, governance, and logging.
Build and maintain Terraform-based Infrastructure as Code and integrate it into CI/CD pipelines.
Design and maintain multi-stage Azure Dev Ops pipelines for infrastructure and platform automation.
Architect and support enterprise networking, including hub-and-spoke topologies and hybrid connectivity.
Support containerized platforms using Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS).
Implement and enforce Azure security, governance, and compliance controls.
Collaborate with application, Dev Ops, security, and infrastructure teams on platform adoption.
Provide technical guidance and architectural direction to engineering teams.
Continuously improve platform reliability, scalability, and operational excellence.
Qualifications
5+ years of hands-on experience designing and operating Azure cloud architectures
Proven experience implementing Azure Landing Zones and Microsoft Cloud Adoption Framework (CAF)
Strong hands-on experience with Terraform (Infrastructure as Code)
Experience with Azure Dev Ops and CI/CD pipelines (YAML)
Advanced English proficiency.
Additional Information
About Us
At Applaudo , we partner with ambitious companies to transform through technology with an AI-native mindset at the core of how we think, build, and deliver. We combine strategic clarity, world-class execution, and modern engineering practices to help clients accelerate measurable business outcomes and stay competitive.
We are building a high-performance culture grounded in five values: Empowering Excellence, Collaborative Teamwork, Unsolicited Respect, Consistent Transparency, and Efficient Communication. These define how we work, how we make decisions, and how we hold ourselves accountable.
Applaudo is a place for people who want to grow fast, take ownership, and work alongside strong teams. Joining us means being part of an organization that is evolving intentionally, investing in modern ways of working, and embracing AI as a lever for productivity, innovation, and impact.

title: Master data modeler
description:
Position Summary and Location
Support the design, development, and maintenance of master data models that ensure the accuracy and consistency of key business data across systems. Collaborate with senior team members to model data structures and optimize data flow, supporting various departments such as finance, sales, and operations. This position is ideal for someone with a passion for data modeling, a keen eye for detail, and a desire to grow in data management and governance.
Duties and Responsibilities
Assist in the design and development of master data models for master domains such as customer, assets, supplier, and financial data.
Help create and maintain data models (conceptual, logical, and physical) that align with business needs and data governance policies.
Ensure the accuracy and integrity of master data by supporting data modeling standards and best practices.
Analyze data from various sources to support data modeling decisions and validate the accuracy and completeness of master data.
Perform basic data profiling and quality checks to identify patterns, anomalies, and potential improvements in data structures.
Collaborate with data quality and data governance teams to ensure consistency across systems.
Assist in designing data flow diagrams and documenting data mappings between different systems.
Work with data engineers and system architects to integrate master data models with existing databases and applications.
Support the creation of data management workflows that optimize data retrieval, storage, and reporting processes.
Help maintain documentation for master data models, including data definitions, relationships, and lineage.
Prepare reports and presentations on data modeling findings and recommendations to stakeholders and team members.
Contribute to the development of metadata repositories and data dictionaries to support enterprise data governance.
Required Qualifications
Bachelor’s degree in data management, Information Systems, Computer Science, or a related field.
Relevant coursework or project experience in data modeling, databases, or data management is a plus.
Basic understanding of data modeling concepts (e.g., entity-relationship models, dimensional modeling) and database structures.
Familiarity with data modeling tools such as Erwin, IBM Info Sphere Data Architect, SAP Power Designer, or similar tools.
Proficiency in SQL for querying databases and understanding relational data structures.
Some exposure to data governance principles, master data management (MDM), and data integration processes.
Desired Qualifications
Hands-on project experience in data modeling, data management, or database design.
Experience working with relational database management systems (RDBMS) such as Oracle, SQL Server, or My SQL.
Familiarity with metadata management and data dictionary tools is a plus.
Location: This position can be located in Rio de Janeiro, Niterói or Macaé.
This opportunity covers disabled or rehabilitated people.

Empreendedorismo: De funcionário para sócio! Temos o Innovation Hub, a Corporate Venture que investe em ideias de profissionais que tenham sinergia com nosso negócio.

Plano de Saúde; Plano Odontológico; Seguro de Vida; Vale Refeição; Vale Alimentação; Horário Flexível; Gympass, Telemedicina, Telenutrição, Canal de suporte emocional 24h e muito mais!

Participar de treinamentos e reuniões da equipe, contribuindo para a melhoria contínua dos serviços.
Garantir a ética e a biossegurança em todos os procedimentos e interações com os pacientes.

Pós-graduação ou cursos complementares em Dermatologia Estética ou áreas afins.
Experiência com tecnologias específicas utilizadas na clínica (ex: ultrassom microfocado, radiofrequência etc.).
Portfólio de casos de sucesso.

title: Especialista de planejamento tributário

ALLOS é uma marca com uma forte herança. São cerca de 50 anos de experiência, transformando o mercado no Brasil. Somos referência em excelência e inovação, com a qualidade e confiança que faz parte da nossa história.
A nova marca surgiu pronta para o futuro, a partir da fusão entre a Aliansce Sonae e a br Malls, em 2023. Mas, essa trajetória começou bem antes.
Tudo começou com a Aliansce, que inaugurou o primeiro shopping da região Nordeste e o segundo do Brasil em 1975. Em 2019, a fusão entre a Aliansce e a Sonae Sierra deu origem à Aliansce Sonae, tornando-se líder na administração de shoppings no Brasil, com 32 empreendimentos. Em 2006, surge a br Malls resultando em um portfólio de 30 ativos presentes nas cinco regiões do país.
E assim, em 2023, a ALLOS surge com o encontro de duas potências nacionais do segmento, unindo forças para se tornar a mais inovadora plataforma de entretenimento, lifestyle, serviços e compras.
Nossa história continua e estamos prontos para criar momentos que transformam e impactam a vida das pessoas, gerando conexões e oportunidades.

Acompanhamento e análise de alterações na legislação tributária e consultoria interna;

Identificação de oportunidades e condução da implementação de projetos, a fim de garantir a maximização dos resultados e a redução de riscos fiscais.

description:

title: Fotógrafo e filmmaker freelancer
description:
Descrição da EmpresaA Outlet de Ouro trabalha com peças em ouro 18k de segunda mão e joias de grandes grifes e alto padrão, em um processo que se inicia com compra de ouro, passa pela manutenção das joias em oficina e termina na exposição e venda das peças via Instagram e E-Commerce. (@outletdeouro).Descrição do CargoEstamos buscando um fotógrafo e filmmaker freelancer para algumas funções mistas, mas todas interligadas no processo da loja. A necessidade que identificamos é ter alguém conosco pelo menos 2 dias na semana, uma vez que temos como demandas principais o seguinte: 1. Tirar fotos e vídeos de mais de 50 novas joias por semana, incluindo diferentes ângulos para a mesma joia; 2. A fotografia e gravação de videos profissionais em estúdio com nossas modelos usando algumas das peças e 3. A criação de conteúdo criativo mobile, como stories de Instagram e Trends de Tiktok, de forma que a criatividade e proatividade são também fundamentais. Fotografia e Edição:Experiência em técnicas fotográficas, composição e edição de imagens utilizando programas como Adobe Photoshop e Lightroom. De preferência experiência semelhante com vídeos.
Organização e Planejamento:Habilidade em planejar cronogramas de sessões fotográficas e gerenciar o tempo de maneira eficaz.
Experiência prévia em fotografia de produtos e editorial com modelos é essencial.

title: Service engineer
description:
Job Summary:
The Service Engineer will be responsible for meeting the daily maintenance and repair needs of customer equipment. They must establish and maintain appropriate business relationships with customers and colleagues, as well as perform necessary administrative activities and other assigned functions.
In this role, your responsibilities will be:
Onboard Service Execution:
Provide support, supervise, and test/troubleshoot field issues onboard vessels and various offshore units. This includes sailing/staying onboard vessels/units while handling services and warranty-related matters.
Execute the requested service in the best possible way to meet customer deadlines and expectations. Commissioning and On-site Sea Trial Execution:
Test, calibrate, and verify the system configuration within Emerson ICMS software and other ICMS supplies and Emerson marine products.
Deliver and obtain approvals from the Shipyard, Owner, and Class during sea trials. Reports / Administrative Activities:
Clearly written work reports must be completed upon returning from trips, in English, detailing all follow-up points.
Onboard service reports must be signed by customers.
Stay up to date on administrative responsibilities such as maintaining internal service reports and internal records in a timely manner. Participation in FAT Tests: Participate in customer equipment workshop tests, together with project engineering, the end customer, and Class. Training:
Participate in all trainings and meetings as required by Emerson.
Participate in, observe, and comply with the company’s health and safety guidelines and contribute to a safe work environment.
Attend local trainings in the workshop/laboratory/classroom in Denmark and other locations as needed to obtain product updates.
Provide basic on-site/onboard training for customers/crews.
Who You Are:
You use customer insights to guide and direct the development of new offerings. You go beyond the obvious and do not stop at the first answers. You anticipate conflicts before they happen, based on your understanding of interpersonal and group dynamics. You act quickly and decisively in unpredictable and fast-changing situations. You take consistent action to develop new skills.
For this role, you will need:
Electrical/Mechanical education with strong knowledge of software and hardware. Additional certifications or training in maintenance, repair, or technical fields related to marine equipment are a plus.
3 years of experience in a similar role, with hands-on troubleshooting, repair, and maintenance of complex technical equipment or systems. Ability to work in a global environment.
Experience dealing with customers in high-pressure environments.
Availability to work overtime, as needed.
Computer literacy and experience with MS Office and Excel.
Fluency in English and Portuguese, written and spoken.
Work location: Rio de Janeiro.
Our Culture and Commitment to You:
At Emerson, we prioritize a workplace where all employees are valued, respected, and empowered to grow. We promote an environment that encourages innovation, collaboration, and diverse perspectives, because we know great ideas come from great teams. Our commitment to continuous career development and fostering an inclusive culture ensures that you have the support to thrive. Whether through mentorship, training, or leadership opportunities, we invest in your success so you can make a lasting impact. We believe that diverse teams, working together, are key to driving growth and delivering business results.
We recognize the importance of employee well-being. We offer medical, dental, pharmacy, and Wellhub (Gympass) benefits; life insurance; credit union; private pension plan; recognition programs, and much more. Our people-focused culture includes resource groups and an employee assistance program, as well as extended parental leave (both maternal and paternal) as part of our Empresa Cidadã certification.

title: Coordenador de segurança da informação e infraestrutura de ti
description:
Estamos em busca de um Coordenador de Segurança da Informação e Infraestrutura de TI que será responsável por coordenar as atividades de Segurança da Informação e Infraestrutura de TI, garantindo a proteção dos ativos digitais e o funcionamento estável e seguro dos ambientes corporativos e críticos da empresa de energia. Atuar como elo entre a estratégia definida pela Superintendência e a execução pelas equipes técnicas, assegurando conformidade regulatória, resiliência operacional e alinhamento com os objetivos do negócio.
Seus desafios serão:

Liderar a equipe de Segurança da Informação e Infraestrutura, promovendo integração entre processos, pessoas e tecnologia.
Implementar e manter políticas, normas e controles de segurança alinhados a frameworks como ISO 27001, NIST CSF, IEC 62443, LGPD e regulamentos setoriais (ANEEL, ONS).
Coordenar atividades de gestão de vulnerabilidades, hardening, monitoração e resposta a incidentes (TI e OT).
Apoiar a operação do SNOC (Security & Network Operations Center) e a interface com o CSIRT, garantindo tempos de resposta adequados a incidentes.
Supervisionar a gestão de identidades e acessos (IAM), controles de rede, servidores e sistemas críticos.
Apoiar o planejamento e a execução de projetos de infraestrutura de TI, assegurando que os requisitos de segurança estejam integrados desde o desenho.
Garantir continuidade operacional e planos de recuperação de desastres (BCP/DRP).

Experiência internacional: Estamos crescendo cada vez mais fora do Brasil e você tem possibilidade de atuar em projetos para outros países, ou diretamente nos países onde a BRQ tem sede.
Empreendedorismo: De funcionário para sócio! Temos o Innovation Hub, a Corporate Venture que investe em ideias de profissionais que tenham sinergia com nosso negócio.

Plano de Saúde; Plano Odontológico; Seguro de Vida; Vale Refeição; Vale Alimentação; Horário Flexível; Atuação híbrida; Gympass, Telemedicina, Telenutrição, Canal de suporte emocional 24h e muito mais!

title: Hr training analyst
description:
Position: HR Training Analyst
Location: Barra da Tijuca, Rio de Janeiro
About Us
MISC Group is a world-leading provider of international energy-related maritime solutions and services.
For over 56 years, we have built a dynamic, progressive, and innovative global brand, delivering the highest standards of maritime services and creating sustainable value for our stakeholders worldwide.
Job Purpose
The HR Training & Personnel Logistics Analyst is responsible for ensuring full compliance of offshore personnel with mandatory training requirements, managing training logistics, and maintaining accurate certification records in DRAKE System.
The role also supports HR strategy implementation, training governance, personnel logistics coordination, and operational workforce readiness in alignment with corporate policies and project needs.
Key Responsibilities
Ensure that all offshore personnel hold valid mandatory training and certifications required for offshore deployment;
Coordinate all logistics arrangements for trainings scheduled in the DRAKE System;
Maintain strict control and timely updates of training and certification records in DRAKE;
Provide HR expertise in developing and implementing training-related policies, processes, and improvement actions according to business needs;
Interpret, apply, and uphold corporate policies and legal requirements with strong customer focus and best practices;
Apply an integrated approach when managing the employee mandatory training cycle (training matrix, gap analysis, deviation notices, certifications, training providers, and budget control) to effectively support Projects and Operations;
Monitor and support the local execution of HR Training policies, procedures, and processes;
Assist in managing the training budget, including creation and follow-up of Purchase Requisitions (PRs) for all training-related expenses;
Coordinate feedback from personnel regarding training provider performance and recommend improvements to management;
Support audits and evaluations of training service providers;
Provide operational support to the Personnel Logistics team, including weekend on-call coverage and emergency demands when required;
Control operational activities related to personnel departure, mobilization, and allocation.
Requirements
Bachelor’s Degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or related field;
Previous experience in offshore operations, oil & gas, or maritime environment preferred;
Experience managing training matrices and certification control systems (DRAKE knowledge is an advantage);
Knowledge of Brazilian labor and maritime regulations is desirable;
Fluent English (minimum intermediate level);
Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and ability to manage multiple priorities;
Proactive profile with strong interface capability between HR and Operations.
Benefits
Meal and food allowances;
Bradesco Health Insurance (extended to family members at no cost, no co-pay);
Life Insurance;
Annual Bonus;
Private Pension Plan;
Childcare Allowance.
Note
This position is open exclusively to Brazilian citizens.
MISC is committed to diversity and inclusion and welcomes applications from professionals of all backgrounds.
